title: Presales Executive (Civil Engineering Background Mandatory)
description: Job Description: Presales Executive (Lead Generation & Business Development) Company Description Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and developing deep large-scale AI and ML solutions for the Construction Industry. With a focus on AI, computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction industry with our innovative AI-powered construction management solution, “Kael” — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, “Observance”, uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as-built intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors. The Role: We are looking for an articulate, proactive Presales Executive with a civil engineering background to drive lead generation and prospect engagement at Inkers. You will be the first voice of Inkers to our prospects: generating leads, following up consistently, understanding what prospects need, and scheduling discovery calls with our Account Managers. You will also represent Inkers at construction-tech summits, trade shows and exhibitions, where many of our best prospects are found. This is a growth role, and with strong performance you will move into an Account Manager position. Key Responsibilities: Lead Generation & Follow-ups Generate new leads through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn and other channels, targeting developers, contractors, EPC firms, PMC and consulting companies. Screen and qualify incoming enquiries and event leads against defined criteria. Follow up with prospects consistently and on time until they are ready for a sales conversation or are disqualified. Prospect Engagement & Call Scheduling Speak with prospects to introduce Inkers and Observance, and understand their project needs and challenges. Schedule and confirm discovery and demo calls between prospects and Account Managers. Brief Account Managers with prospect background and requirements before every call. Research prospects and companies to enrich lead data. Events & Industry Presence Participate in construction-tech summits, trade shows, exhibitions and webinars; engage visitors and capture leads. Coordinate event preparation with the team and run structured post-event follow-ups. Be willing to travel for events when required. Database, Reporting & Sales Support Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of leads and conversations in the CRM and sales database. Track and report key metrics: calls made, conversations held, meetings scheduled and lead conversion. Support the sales team with documentation, presentations and proposals when required. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Civil Engineering; an MBA is an added advantage. Excellent spoken and written communication in English; confident on calls and in face-to-face conversations. Knowledge of Hindi or Kannada is an advantage. Prior experience in presales, inside sales, business development or lead generation is preferred; strong freshers are welcome. Good understanding of construction processes and project lifecycle; awareness of BIM or construction technology is a plus. Comfortable with cold calling and persistent follow-ups; self-motivated, organised and target-driven. Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools. Keen to build a career in B2B technology sales and grow into an Account Manager role. Career Growth: Presales Executive to Account Manager, based on performance and demonstrated ownership of the prospect journey. What We Offer: Opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects in the construction technology sector. A defined growth path from Presales to Account Manager. Exposure to industry events, summits and senior decision-makers in construction. Collaborative and innovative work environment. Competitive salary and benefits package. Access to the latest scanning and modeling technologies. Work Location: Bangalore (On-site), with occasional travel for events

title: Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO)
description: MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.We are seeking a highly technical, visionary, and customer-centric Field CTO to act as our premier technical ambassador. In this role, you will bridge the gap between MinIO’s engineering innovation and the strategic business needs of our largest, most complex enterprise customers.As a Field CTO, you will engage in peer-to-peer conversations with enterprise C-suites (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs) and lead architectural discussions with principal engineers. A deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI architectures (LLMs, RAG, deep learning pipelines) and modern analytics data systems (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Trino, Spark) is mandatory. You will not only evangelize MinIO’s capabilities but also act as a trusted advisor, helping organizations architect their data infrastructure to support next-generation workloads.What You Will DoExecutive Advisory & Evangelism: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies. Articulate the strategic value of high-performance object storage in the context of AI readiness and data democratization.Architectural Leadership: Design and validate complex, large-scale architectures for enterprise customers. Guide them in integrating MinIO seamlessly into their AI/ML pipelines and modern data lakehouse ecosystems.Industry Thought Leadership: Represent MinIO at major industry conferences, webinars, and meetups. Write technical whitepapers, reference architectures, and blog posts focusing on the intersection of object storage, generative AI, and modern analytics.Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Strategic Support: Partner closely with enterprise sales and customer success teams on high-stakes deals. Unblock technical objections and provide strategic guidance during Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and large-scale deployments.Product Strategy Feedback Loop: Serve as the "voice of the customer" to MinIO’s product and engineering teams. Distill market trends, customer pain points, and emerging AI/Analytics patterns into actionable product requirements.Required Qualifications10+ years of experience in technical leadership roles (e.g., Enterprise Architect, Chief Architect, VP of Engineering, or previous Field CTO).Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing or evangelist capacity, successfully presenting to both highly technical audiences and C-level business executives.AI & Machine Learning ArchitecturesDeep architectural understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).Strong knowledge of AI/ML data pipelines and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ray, Hugging Face).Understanding of hardware bottlenecks in AI, specifically the challenge of feeding data to GPUs (GPU data starvation) and how high-throughput storage solves this.Modern Analytics & Data SystemsExpertise in Open Table Formats (Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Delta Lake) and their integration with object storage.Proficiency with modern query engines and compute frameworks (Trino, Presto, Apache Spark, Flink, StarRocks).Solid grasp of the evolution from traditional data warehouses to modern Data Lakehouse architectures.Infrastructure & Cloud-Native TechStrong command of Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native orchestration.Deep understanding of the AWS S3 API, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems design.Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Solutions Engineer – Public Sector | Splunk Security
description:
**Meet the Team**
Join Splunk, a Cisco company solution engineering team supporting Public Sector customers and helping organizations address complex security and technology challenges. In this role, you’ll work closely with government and Public Sector organizations, partners, and cross-functional sales teams to deliver innovative Cisco and Splunk security solutions. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers strengthen their security posture while driving adoption and growth across the portfolio.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Technical Sales Professional, You Will**

* Own the technical relationship with Public Sector customers and partners, serving as a trusted technical advisor and primary technical sales influencer.
* Partner with account and sales teams on strategic account planning, identifying growth opportunities and aligning technical strategies with Public Sector customer objectives.
* Engage with IT and security leaders, technical decision-makers, and lines of business to understand customer environments, security challenges, business priorities, and technical requirements.
* Translate customer business and security needs into innovative Cisco and Splunk Security solutions and lead strategic solution conversations.
* Design and present cross-architecture security solutions, demonstrations, and technical presentations that address complex Public Sector challenges.
* Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, helping move opportunities from technical discovery and validation through closure.
* Leverage strong knowledge of Splunk Security technologies, including Splunk Cloud, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk-Based Alerting (RBA), Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, Mission Control, and security analytics.
* Apply knowledge of security technologies and architectures including SOC, incident response, threat hunting, XDR/EDR, network security, cloud security, Zero Trust, and security operations to develop relevant customer solutions.
* Leverage competitive market insights to position and differentiate Cisco and Splunk solutions against competing security platforms.
* Coordinate and influence virtual teams of sales resources, security specialists, internal stakeholders, and external partners to drive customer success.
* Provide feedback to Business Entities (BEs) and relevant sales teams on strategic Public Sector customer needs, security trends, market opportunities, and competitive tactics.
* Contribute to demand-generation, technical enablement, and education initiatives that strengthen Cisco and Splunk security capabilities across the Public Sector.
* Adapt technical and engagement strategies to evolving Public Sector priorities, cybersecurity threats, technology trends, and market conditions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 7+ years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 4+ years of related experience, or PhD with 1+ year of related experience.
* 7+ years of experience in technical sales, solutions engineering, security consulting, cybersecurity, or a related customer-facing technical role.
* Experience engaging with Public Sector customers, IT/security leaders, technical decision-makers, and business stakeholders.
* Experience designing, presenting, and demonstrating security or technology solutions aligned to customer business challenges.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, security analytics, threat detection, incident response, or security operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Public Sector or government customers, particularly within complex or regulated environments.
* Strong knowledge of Splunk Security, including Splunk Enterprise Security, SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, Risk-Based Alerting, Threat Intelligence, and security analytics.
* Experience across XDR/EDR, Network Security, Cloud Security, Zero Trust, Threat Hunting, SOC, and Incident Response.
* Experience driving cross-sell, up-sell, competitive displacement, or market-share growth within strategic accounts.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity trends, customer environments, and competitive security technologies.
* Experience influencing technical executives and leading strategic security solution conversations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. title: Senior Applied Value Engineer- (Hi-tech)
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
As a Senior Applied Value Engineer you push the envelope in solving mission-critical problems for our customers. You will work with our most strategic customers, understand their strategy and key challenges, and build Celonis solutions using cutting-edge AI technologies from market leaders such as Microsoft and OpenAI. With Celonis’ market-leading Process Intelligence (PI) Platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ businesses and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization to increase Celonis' footprint at those customers.
  
  
**The Role:**
As Senior Applied Value Engineer, responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**

* AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
* Identify & Frame Value: Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives
* Realize Value: Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives
* Scale Value: Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use case

**The qualifications you need:**

* Live for Customer Value: 9+ years of experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise. Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP/ Oracle), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Hands-on Experience with Process Mining tools and technologies is preferred. Hands-on SQL experience and Python is preferred . Experience in collaborating with IT teams.
* Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying business use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value. Domain and industry knowledge such as Supply chain, finance, CPG, BFSI, Manufacturing etc. would be a plus.
* Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
  
  
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Senior Field Technical Director
description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
  
  
We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
  
  
**Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?**
A Field Technical Director is an architect-level role focused on ensuring the best design & integration of Cohesity technology for large, enterprise customers and those with demanding use cases. The mission of this role is to ensure the customer's technical requirements are …
  
  

* Explored, understood, and captured to ensure that the proposed architecture will meet their needs
* Translated into solutions that will be successfully implemented and that will ensure repeat business

This position needs to be an expert on the core Cohesity product capabilities. Expertise in data center design and practices -- as well as data protection, distributed systems, and solutions at web scale -- are essential.
  
  
**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE:**

* Present Cohesity technology (deep dive) to customer executives, technical leaders/experts and explain how it is applied in various use-cases/scenarios
* Conduct discovery workshops with the customer to identify business objectives, document use cases/requirements, and operational constraints
* Develop high-level architectural alternatives, review with customers, and deliver (written) design plans to meet the customer's needs (especially “at scale”) and includes considerations of special phases of the project (e.g. migration, operational cut-over) for Cohesity implementation teams to follow
* Help plan and conduct technical demos and Proof of Concepts (POCs) with the account SE
* Provide technical information for RFPs/RFIs
* Provide technical review for all account team proposals
* Liaison with Product Management and Engineering to represent customer/field requirements and resolve specific issues
* Act as technical point of escalation for all architectural and design decisions
* Act as a leader in your territory and across the FTD squad
* Drive results leading product focused cross-functional teams

**WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of experience in IT
* Experience in these technical areas required
* Storage, Backup, Virtualization, Linux CLI
* Additional experience highly desirable:
* Disaster Recovery/Business Continuance
* Database Protection and Recovery
* Distributed Systems
* Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)

title: Solutions Architect (PST/EST Customer Hours)
description:
**About Glean:**

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

**About the Role:**

Glean is seeking a talented Solutions Architect (SA) to join our rapidly expanding, venture-backed startup. Glean is the Work AI platform — powering intelligent search, AI assistants, and scalable AI agents for the world's largest enterprises. Join our hard-working team and elevate your career. We are professional, creative, passionate, and, most importantly — customer-obsessed.

This is not a traditional SA role where you build slide decks. You will write code, build working prototypes, and ship real integrations alongside the customers who use them. If you love toggling between building something technical and advising a customer on how to deploy it, this role is for you.

You will be the primary technical advisor to our customers post-sale, focusing on our Enterprise and Strategic segment, where the architecture and integration demands are high. You will guide customers through their architecture, design, and implementation of Glean within their enterprise environment — and you will build alongside them, not just advise.

**You will:**

* Establish and maintain your role as the customer's primary technical advisor. Think of yourself as the CTO of the customer relationship.
* Build working prototypes, tools, and integrations using Glean APIs (Indexing, Search, Chat), RAG workflows, MCP tools, and agent frameworks — directly with and for customers.
* Onboard new data sources and implement custom integrations of Glean into customer work environments and business application architectures.
* Identify and drive expansion opportunities — including AI assistants, agents, and API-driven applications — within each customer's architecture.
* Provide training and guidance to customer technical resources to enable them to manage, support, and extend Glean in their environment.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues for your assigned customers, from log analysis to end-to-end transaction tracing.
* Work with Product Management and Engineering to drive product improvements based on patterns you observe across customer engagements.

**About you:**

6 to 10 years of experience in Solutions Architect, or related roles.

*Interpersonal skills:*

* Communication: professional presentation and interaction skills with both customers and internal teams. Able to explain complex AI and integration concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Project planning: plan and execute the implementation of customer projects.
* Self-motivated: a proactive approach to delivering service to customers.
* Detail-oriented: highly organized and methodical, ensuring all issues are managed to completion.
* Data-driven: utilize metrics and objective measurements to assess success and improvement opportunities for customers.
* Pre or Post-sales Solution Architect experience in a product-led company is a huge plus.

*Technical skills:*

* Software development experience in at least two of the following: Python, Java, Go. You write code regularly — not just in the past.
* Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications: RAG pipelines, chatbots, AI assistants, or agentic workflows using LLMs.
* API and custom data integration experience in a Hybrid or SaaS environment. Experience with Indexing, Search, or Chat APIs is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI developer tooling such as LangChain, vector databases, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Technical debugging: log analysis, code analysis, end-to-end transaction tracing.
* Networking expertise: a deep understanding of networking, including cloud and on-premise networking.
* Experience in at least two of the following disciplines: Software Engineering, Pre-Sales Engineering, Post-Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Developer Relations, Forward Deployed Engineering, or Technical Customer Delivery.
* Hands-on experience with Cloud technologies in at least one of the following: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure.
* Security and audit experience: able to fully understand the technical and audit framework of the product and represent it with customer security and audit stakeholders.

*AI fluency:*

* You use AI tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as part of how you work — not just what you build.
* You can demonstrate something you have personally built using AI, explain how it works, debug it live, and defend your technical choices.
* You are comfortable building and demoing working prototypes under time constraints.

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)

title: Industry Consultant - Manufacturing (Discrete & industrial)
description:
**Role**
: Industry Consultant – Manufacturing (Discrete & Industrial)

**Location**
: Pune, Hyderabad, Bengaluru

**Experience**
: 12 - 15 years

**Mode**
: Hybrid

The Industry Consultant – Manufacturing (Discrete & Industrial) gives the Enterprise Consulting unit a true industry expert who knows how manufacturers actually run, from quote to cash and from plan to production. The role adds that sector depth to the unit's five domain pillars: Customer Experience (Cx), IT Service Management (ITSM), ERP, Human Capital Management (HCM) and Supply Chain Management (SCM). The person must understand the core industry processes from the manufacturer's own point of view, for example how Lead-to-Cash works for configurable and engineered products, with quoting, dealer networks, make-to-order and engineer-to-order flows, and milestone billing, rather than as a generic order flow. This is a senior, client-facing and practice-building role. The person will shape industry-specific offerings, lead executive conversations, and support the unit through sales, presales and partnership alliances. They will also create new consulting services and thought leadership, including AI and agentic solutions for manufacturing clients.

**Responsibilities**

* Key Responsibilities
* Industry overlay on the pillars. Translate discrete and industrial manufacturing context (machinery and equipment, automotive and components, aerospace and defense, durable goods) into points of view, reference architectures, use cases and accelerators for Cx, ITSM, ERP, HCM and SCM.
* Process consulting. Lead current-state assessments, process redesign and operating-model work across the industry's end-to-end processes, including Lead-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Plan-to-Produce, Design-to-Release and Issue-to-Resolution.
* Process intelligence. Use process mining and process intelligence tools to baseline performance, expose friction such as quote delays, schedule changes and late deliveries, and build the value case for transformation.
* Sales and presales. Qualify industry opportunities, run executive discovery, build solution narratives, and support proposals, orals and client workshops.
* Partnership alliances. Build joint propositions with technology partners and ecosystem players relevant to the industry, and co-create go-to-market plays with them.
* Thought leadership. Publish points of view and whitepapers, speak at industry forums, and represent the unit in analyst briefings and client events.
* AI and agentic solutions. Define high-value AI and agentic use cases for the industry, such as quote and configuration assistants, demand and supply exception handling, predictive maintenance, quality inspection insights, warranty claim validation and service triage.
* New consulting services. Conceive, package and launch new industry consulting services, from concept and pricing logic to delivery playbooks and consultant enablement.
* Delivery advisory. Act as the domain advisor on live engagements, review deliverables for industry accuracy, and coach consultants across the pillars on industry context.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, supply chain, technology or business.

**Required Skills**

* 12–15 years in consulting or industry-plus-consulting roles, with at least 8 years focused on discrete and industrial manufacturing clients.
* Demonstrated industry-expert knowledge of the end-to-end processes listed above, including Lead-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay and Plan-to-Produce, and the ability to explain them from the manufacturer's point of view.
* Consulting experience across technology stacks aligned to the pillars (CRM and CX, ITSM, ERP, HCM, SCM), with depth in at least two and working knowledge of the rest. Platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle and Workday are typical.
* Domain depth in at least two segments: industrial machinery and equipment, automotive and components, aerospace and defense, or durable goods.
* Proven process consulting skills: process discovery, BPMN modelling, value stream mapping, operating-model design and benchmarking.
* Working knowledge of process intelligence and process mining tools, and experience turning their findings into a business case.
* Track record in sales and presales: shaped and won enterprise deals, and presented to C-suite audiences.
* Experience building consulting propositions, partner alliances and published thought leadership.

**Preferred Skills**

* MBA or a postgraduate degree in engineering management, operations or supply chain.
* Exposure to process industries (batch and recipe-based production) as an added strength.
* Platform, process or framework certifications, such as Salesforce, ServiceNow or SAP certifications, APICS (CSCP or CPIM), Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, TOGAF or a process mining tool certification.
* Familiarity with industry systems around the core platforms, such as MES, PLM, CPQ and IoT or connected-product platforms.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI and agentic frameworks, and with responsible AI governance for enterprise use.
* Published articles, conference talks or analyst recognition in manufacturing or Industry 4.0 transformation.
* Experience working with global delivery models and distributed teams.

title: Proposal Associate
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

* Client Go / No Go and Account Reviews and Focus Windows as required.

* When leading an opportunity, manage and work with team to develop response sections, especially value propositions and Executive Summaries or else check compliance of opportunities.

Here's what you'll need

title: Engineer
description:
**Job title: Engineer - Aftermarket Sales**
**Location: Bangalore**
**About Us**
Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Aftermarket Sales Engineer for Power Tools and Industrial Lifting is responsible for maximizing lifecycle value of customer assets through preventive maintenance, OEM spare parts, repairs, refurbishment, modernization, and long-term service agreements. By leveraging Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles, the role helps customers improve safety, reliability, and productivity while reducing downtime and overall operating costs, thereby driving sustainable aftermarket growth and recurring revenue for the business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Maintain a comprehensive database of installed power tools and industrial lifting equipment within the assigned territory.

* Identify aftermarket opportunities across the entire equipment lifecycle.

* Analyze equipment operating hours, service history, usage patterns, and failure trends.
* Recommend replacement of wear parts before failure occurs.
* Drive sales of preventive maintenance kits and scheduled replacement components.
* Convert inspection findings into spare parts and service orders.

* Demonstrate how preventive maintenance can reduce:
* Unplanned downtime
* Emergency repair costs
* Production losses
* Overtime maintenance expenses
* Safety incidents
* Equipment replacement costs

**Develop Business Cases Comparing**

* Preventive maintenance vs. corrective maintenance
* OEM parts vs. non-genuine parts
* Repair vs. replacement decisions
* Planned shutdown maintenance vs. emergency breakdown repairs

**Position Services And Parts As Tools To**

* Extend asset life
* Reduce maintenance expenditure
* Enhance productivity
* Improve equipment availability
* Improve return on asset investment
* Conduct equipment condition assessments and site surveys.
* Perform health checks for lifting equipment and power tools.
* Identify worn-out or safety-critical components.
* Generate inspection reports with maintenance recommendations.
* Develop commercial proposals based on audit findings.
* Support customers in complying with safety and statutory inspection requirements.
* Identify opportunities for equipment refurbishment and rebuild projects.
* Promote overhaul programs to restore equipment performance.
* Recommend repair solutions based on equipment condition.
* Provide customers with cost-benefit analysis of repair versus replacement.
* Coordinate repair activities with service centers and field teams.

**Promote And Secure**

* Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
* Preventive Maintenance Agreements
* Inspection Contracts
* Calibration Services
* Repair and Overhaul Agreements

**Responsibilities Include**

* Contract renewals
* Contract profitability
* Multi-year service agreements
* Expansion of service coverage across customer sites
* Prepare technical and commercial quotations.
* Coordinate with service, operations, procurement, and supply chain teams.
* Ensure competitive pricing while maintaining profitability.
* Negotiate contracts and service agreements.
* Follow up quotations and improve order conversion rates.
* Monitor open opportunities through CRM systems.

**Achieve Targets For**

* Spare parts sales
* Service revenue
* Repair revenue
* AMC revenue
* Refurbishment projects
* Upgrade projects
* Improve aftermarket attachment rates.
* Increase recurring revenue through long-term service agreements.
* Manage profitability and gross margin performance.
* Drive sustainable growth within the installed base.

**Collaborate Closely With**

* Service Engineers
* Service Managers
* Product Specialists
* Supply Chain Teams
* Repair Centers
* Operations Teams
* Sales Teams
* Customer Maintenance Teams
* Map key customer assets and maintenance cycles.
* Develop account-specific aftermarket strategies.
* Identify high-revenue lifecycle opportunities.
* Track competitor activities and market trends.
* Position the company as a lifecycle reliability partner rather than simply a spare parts supplier.

**Requirements**

* Qualitification can be BE in Mechatronics, Mechanical or Electrical, MBA an added advantage
* 5-7 years in handling customers

**Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements**

* 70-80% Travel (As and When required)

* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

title: Area Manager - EVPV
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Field Application Engineer (FAE) plays a crucial role in bridging the technical aspects of products and solutions with the requirements and challenges faced by customers. This role involves providing technical support, mentorship, and expertise to customers, sales teams, and internal collaborators. FAEs are responsible for understanding customer needs, demonstrating product capabilities, fixing technical issues, and ensuring customer requirements are explained accurately to Internal Costing/E2e Team
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Support: Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support to customers, including product demonstrations, technical consultations, and solution recommendations.
* Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with customers by understanding their technical requirements, challenges, and objectives.
* Training and Knowledge Transfer: Conduct technical training sessions for customers, sales teams, and partners to improve their understanding of product features, capabilities, and guidelines.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain user documentation, application notes, and other collateral to support customer engagements and internal information exchange.
* Sales Support: Assist the sales team in technical discussions, presentations, and proposal development to effectively communicate the value proposition of company products and solutions.
* Travel: Travel to customer sites as needed to provide on-site support, conduct training sessions, and participate in customer meetings and events.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical or Electrical
* Proven experience in a technical customer-facing role, such as field application engineering, technical consulting (5+ Years)
* Strong understanding of hardware and software systems, including embedded systems, networking, and software development.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Tools like Excel, Power Point
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences effectively.
* Problem-solving skills and the ability to fix technical issues independently.
* Experience with customer relationship management (CRM) tools like Sales Forces.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required (typically 25-50% travel).
* The Field Application Engineer plays a pivotal role in driving customer satisfaction and business growth by ensuring successful adoption and implementation of company products and solutions.

**We Have**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day

+ nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
+ Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com.

* Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work

+ We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
+ Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

- Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

* Innovative & adaptable
* Dedicated to absolute integrity
* Focused on the customer first
* Respectful and team oriented
* Optimistic and energizing
* Accountable for performance
* Benefits to support the lives of our employees

At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

title: Application Engineer III
description:
**About India Sales Support CoE**
India Sales Support CoE organization entails of 792+ engineers supporting Johnson's Controls branches across the world for 20+ years. We are a global organization with field experiences across the different markets right from Asia to North America, Europe to Latin America, and the Middle East. The collected diverse experience in one single organization enables us to be an effective partner for our JCI branches. This engineering organization offers controls, Security & Fire and Energy solution.
  
  
**About Fire & Security Business**
10+ years of wide JCI/Tyco and third-party system knowledge for design, detailed engineering and implementation of Fire Protection and Suppression system. Team provides the services and value-added solutions for the system and provides onsite & remote engineering support across the globe for engineering.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end-to-end presales engineering activities of Fire protection & Suppression opportunities from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno-Commercial activities of the projects covering various such as Fire Sprinkler, Hydrant, water spray, foam and gas suppression Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D&E and OPS approval for booking.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Review the project inputs and project intake form shared by the Front desk/Sales.
* Analyze the requirement and initiate the Kick-off call with Front Desk after getting CoE SFDC Code and time frame.
* Prepare designs on given floor plans to arrive with the BOQ; in case BOQ is unavailable.
* Identify potential issues/risks and proactively bring them to the customer's knowledge and help to mitigate the identified risks.
* Initiate the discussion with OEMs & subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.
* Analyze the proposal and commercials received from the OEM and verify the same based on the past data and benchmark costing available in the SCM Database.
* Upon completion of cost comparison, prepare the optimized techno-commercial Costing sheet, Proposal, and Compliance Statements.
* Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
* Perform 2nd level QC of the deliverables done by other Application Engineers in the team
* Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet & assigned training on time.
* Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
* Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.
* Actively derive the strategy for increasing the win rate.
* Align with Organization KPIs such as Quality, Cycle Time, OTD, Win rate, Productivity, etc.

**What We Look For**

* BE (Mechanical / Electrical)
* Must have 6+ years of relevant experience in Fire Protection & Suppression Systems domains.
* Strong knowledge of Fire Protection & Suppression Systems (Fire Sprinkler, Pre-action system, Water spray, standpipe & hose system, Hydrant network, Fire water storage, Stationary pumps, Foam suppression, water mist system, Kitchen hood system, Gas Suppression – FM, Novec, Inergen & Co2 etc.).
* Knowledge in Building Management System will be added advantage for the role.
* Must have presales and estimation experience on various verticals (Transportation, Commercial, Fit-outs, Industries, Data Centers, etc.).
* Capable of performing hydraulic and flow calculation and doing product selections along with the deviation/compliance statements.
* Must be able to work on complex costing sheets covering Material, Engineering, Operations, and Subcon costs.
* Skill in articulating offered solutions in a structured way through high-standard technical proposal documents.
* Must build a strong network with the 3rd party vendors regionally specific.
* Must be a quick learner & keen on problem-solving techniques.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Must be a good team player.

**Preferred**

* Experienced in designing Fire Protection & Suppression systems (fire hydrant, sprinkler, HVWS, MVWS, Foam, Water Mist, Gas Suppression) per NFPA, BSEN, Vds, TAC, and NBC norms.
* Proficient in hydraulic and flow calculations using SprinkCAD, Fire-CAD, ANSUL, and HYGOOD.
* Preparing the bill of quantity (BOQ) & material track sheet as per approved / shop drawings and material technical data sheet.
* Coordination with consultants / clients for contractual clarifications and to get the approval of design.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, Sprink CAD, Fire CAD, Navis and Excel.

For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou.

title: Applications Engineer
description:
Company Overview:
  
  
Flowserve is a global manufacturer of pumps, valves, seals, and aftermarket services, delivering comprehensive flow control solutions that support essential industries such as energy, clean water, and pharmaceuticals. If you're looking for a culture built on ingenuity, innovation, and excellence, Flowserve offers the opportunity to put your experience in motion. Whether you're an individual contributor or a people leader, you'll find meaningful opportunities for professional growth, competitive rewards, and a workplace grounded in our core values: People, Safety, Integrity, Ownership and Ingenuity. At Flowserve, we're inspired by what we can achieve together—creating extraordinary flow control solutions that strengthen today's world while building tomorrow.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
The Applications Engineer is responsible for preparing competitive techno-commercial quotations for intercompany and third-party customers for Projects and MRO business. The role involves reviewing technical requirements, selecting suitable control valves and accessories, coordinating with internal teams and suppliers, and ensuring timely and accurate proposal submission.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* Prepare techno-commercial quotations for standard and special control valves for assigned regions and intercompany requirements.
* Review project specifications, valve datasheets, process data, vendor documents, inspection, and testing requirements.
* Select suitable valves, actuators, and accessories based on application requirements.
* Prepare technical deviations and clarification lists with appropriate justification.
* Coordinate with factories, suppliers, legal, operations, and credit analysis teams for quotation support.
* Respond to customer technical clarifications and participate in technical discussions when required.
* Review purchase orders and contracts to ensure alignment with submitted proposals.
* Complete order hand-off documentation and transfer documents to respective manufacturing plants.
* Prepare and maintain pre-qualification dossiers and quotation logs.
* Meet assigned functional metrics for quotation quality, accuracy, and turnaround time.

**Main Objectives:**

* Deliver accurate, timely, and competitive techno-commercial proposals.
* Ensure technical compliance with customer and project requirements.
* Support order conversion through effective application engineering and commercial coordination.
* Ensure smooth order hand-off from sales to manufacturing plants.
* Maintain complete quotation records and support continuous improvement in bid processes.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering.
* 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in the valve industry.
* Experience in application engineering, control valve selection, actuators, and accessories.
* Knowledge of project specifications, process datasheets, inspection, and testing requirements.
* Exposure to techno-commercial bidding, proposal preparation, and order hand-off processes.
* Commercial knowledge and experience working with international customers will be preferred.

**Competencies:**

* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Good technical understanding of control valves and application engineering.
* Techno-commercial and business acumen.
* Negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple quotations.
* Creative, proactive, and energetic approach.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.

**Req ID**
: R-21502
  
  
**Job Family Group**
: Sales
  
  
**Job Family**
: SA Applications Engineering

title: Senior Applied Value Engineer | DACH | Logistics
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
As an Senior Applied Value Engineer you push the envelope in solving mission-critical problems for our customers. You will work with our most strategic customers, understand their strategy and key challenges, and build Celonis solutions using cutting-edge AI technologies from market leaders such as Microsoft and OpenAI. With Celonis’ market-leading Process Intelligence (PI) Platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ businesses and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization to increase Celonis' footprint at those customers..
  
  
**The Role:**
As an Senior Applied Value Engineer, responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**

* AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
* Identify & Frame Value: Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executives
* Realize Value: Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives
* Scale Value: Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use case

**The qualifications you need:**

* Live for Customer Value: 7+ years of experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise. Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP/ Oracle), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Hands-on Experience with Process Mining tools and technologies is preferred. Hands-on SQL experience and Python is preferred . Experience in collaborating with IT teams.
* Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying business use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value. Domain and industry knowledge such as Supply chain, finance, CPG, BFSI, Manufacturing etc. would be a plus.
* Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
