title: Insurance – Domain Consultant
description:
**About The Role**
As an Insurance Domain Expert, you will make an impact by driving business development across our insurance advisory and technology practice — engaging life insurers, general insurers, reinsurers, insurance brokers, and InsurTech players to develop and close strategic engagements. As a trusted advisor, you will shape CX-CRM solutions across underwriting, claims, distribution, actuarial, and regulatory domains, and build long-term relationships at the C-suite and functional leadership levels, bringing deep insurance domain expertise to every pursuit. You will be a valued member of the Cognizant Moment (Business Development) team and work collaboratively with delivery, technology, and account teams, as well as senior client stakeholders across the insurance industry.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Serve as the primary domain authority on insurance products, processes, and regulations across Life & Annuities, P&C, Health & Group Benefits, Commercial & Specialty Lines, Reinsurance, and Distribution & Claims, and co-create tailored solutions spanning core system modernisation, distribution analytics, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance.
* Shape and close deals built on platforms such as Salesforce, Adobe, Genesys, and AWS Contact Center, ensuring solutions are designed around policyholder data privacy, suitability, claims-handling, and consent requirements.
* Conduct discovery workshops, As-Is assessments, and strategic roadmap sessions with senior client stakeholders, and deliver senior-level presentations that drive alignment and decisions.
* Act as a trusted advisor through the full client lifecycle — from initial outreach and solution scoping through delivery oversight and account expansion — and represent the firm at IRDAI forums, CII events, industry summits, and InsurTech conferences to strengthen brand visibility and generate qualified leads.
* Contribute to the development of insurance practice offerings, point-of-view papers, and thought leadership content, monitor regulatory developments to translate them into go-to-market opportunities, and mentor junior consultants to support practice growth.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore, Chennai, or Hyderabad. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* 10-15+ years of experience in the insurance industry, with at least 4 years in a business development, pre-sales, or consulting capacity.
* Proven track record of independently winning and managing engagements of INR 3 Cr+ in the insurance sector, with experience working with or selling to life insurers, general insurers, standalone health insurers, or reinsurers.
* Comprehensive knowledge of the insurance value chain: product development, underwriting, policy administration, claims, reinsurance, and distribution.
* Familiarity with insurance compliance and regulatory requirements (KYC/AML, suitability/best-interest, GDPR/CCPA, IRDAI/NAIC/EIOPA-FCA) and how they shape CX & Digital Experience solution design.
* Bachelor's degree in Insurance, Actuarial Science, Finance, Business, or a related field, together with strong executive presence and excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.

**These will help you stand out**

* MBA, FIII/AIII, or ACII designation.
* Hands-on understanding of CX & Digital Experience platforms including Salesforce (Financial Services Cloud / Insurance), Adobe Experience Cloud, Genesys / NICE / AWS Connect, and core insurance systems (Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, FINEOS).
* Proven ability to build C-suite relationships and independently win and manage large-scale, complex insurance engagements.
* Knowledge of Agentic AI & Next-Gen AI Virtual Assistants, hyper-personalisation, unified omnichannel journeys, and consent-based engagement trends in insurance.
* Ability to track regulatory shifts across India (IRDAI), North America (NAIC, OSFI), and Europe/UK (EIOPA, FCA, PRA) and translate them into CX and Digital Experience requirements.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Field Architect
description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
The Field Architect role at MinIO is a senior customer-facing technical leadership position focused on defining, validating, and guiding AIStor architectures for AI, analytics, cloud-native applications, and large-scale data infrastructure. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams, translating business and application requirements into robust technical designs that deliver measurable outcomes.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with the broader MinIO team to ensure customers are successful through technical discovery, architecture design, proof-of-value execution, production onboarding, performance validation, and long-term expansion. Success in this role requires deep technical curiosity, hands-on architecture skills, strong communication, and the ability to connect AIStor’s capabilities to the data-intensive workloads that matter most to our customers.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Technical Architecture and Discovery: Lead technical discovery with customers and partners to understand their business goals, application requirements, data architecture, infrastructure constraints, and success criteria. Define scalable AIStor architectures that map directly to those requirements.
* AI and Analytics Workload Design: Define and validate AIStor architectures for AI/ML training and inference, analytics platforms, data lakehouse environments, high-performance data pipelines, large object workloads, and modern application data services.
* Object Storage and S3 Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert in object storage, S3-compatible architectures, distributed systems, metadata, replication, erasure coding, security, performance tuning, and large-scale namespace design.

Customer Engagement & Advisory
  
  

* Customer Technical Advisor: Build trusted relationships with customer technical stakeholders, including infrastructure, platform, analytics, AI, security, application, and operations teams. Guide customers toward informed architecture decisions and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, resilience, scale, and operational efficiency.
* Proof-of-Value Execution: Lead technical evaluations, system configurations, performance testing, interoperability validation, and proof-of-value engagements that demonstrate AIStor’s value in real customer environments.
* Customer Success Beyond the Win: Partner with Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering teams to help customers move from evaluation to production and from initial deployment to broader adoption across additional workloads, teams, and use cases.

Ecosystem, Enablement & Field Operations
  
  

* Cloud-Native and Kubernetes Guidance: Provide technical leadership on Kubernetes, containers, automation, and cloud-native deployment patterns, including hybrid cloud, private cloud, public cloud, and edge infrastructure models.
* Solution Integration and Ecosystem Collaboration: Work with technology partners, reseller partners, and customer teams to support complete solutions involving analytics engines, AI platforms, Kubernetes distributions, data protection tools, identity systems, observability platforms, and public cloud services.
* Technical Presentations and Enablement: Build and deliver compelling architecture presentations, whiteboard sessions, demonstrations, best practices, workshops, and technical enablement sessions for customers, partners, and internal teams.
* RFP, RFI, and Technical Response Support: Contribute to or lead technical portions of RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, security reviews, architecture questionnaires, and competitive evaluations.

Product Intelligence & Market Expertise
  
  

* Product and Engineering Feedback: Advocate for customer requirements internally by capturing field feedback, competitive insights, workload patterns, integration needs, and enhancement opportunities. Work with Product and Engineering teams to help inform roadmap priorities and improve customer outcomes.
* Competitive and Market Expertise: Stay current on object storage, data lakehouse, AI infrastructure, analytics, Kubernetes, cloud, and competitive storage trends. Help internal teams and customers understand where AIStor is differentiated.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Strong background in enterprise storage, object storage, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or high-performance data-intensive applications.
* Strong understanding of object storage concepts and S3-compatible architectures; experience with HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, security models, replication, data protection, and scale-out system design is highly valuable.
* 10+ years of experience in a senior customer-facing technical role such as Field Architect, Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, or Technical Consultant.
* Hands-on experience with Linux, networking, storage systems, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, and modern data center infrastructure.
* Experience designing or supporting AI, machine learning, analytics, data lakehouse, or large-scale data pipeline environments.
* Familiarity with ecosystem technologies such as Databricks, Starburst, Spark, Trino, Iceberg, Delta Lake, Kafka, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or other AI and analytics frameworks is a strong plus.
* Experience with public cloud and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, or private cloud platforms.
* Ability to conduct technical discovery, design architectures, build demonstrations, guide proof-of-value execution, analyze performance, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
* Comfortable working with heterogeneous enterprise environments involving compute, storage, networking, security, identity, observability, backup, disaster recovery, and application teams.
* Strong verbal, written, whiteboarding, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively across customers, partners, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Engineering teams.
* Strong customer-success orientation, intellectual curiosity, sense of ownership, and ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-moving environment.
* Willingness to travel as needed to support customers, partners, field events, and internal team activities.

title: GEN AI- SM- AIA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
Assistant Director – AI / GenAI (Go-To-Market)
  
  
The Data and Analytics team is a multidisciplinary technology team that delivers client projects and solutions across data mining and management, visualization, business analytics, automation, statistical insights, and AI/GenAI. Assignments span a wide range of countries and industry sectors.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
We are looking for an Assistant Director - AI/GenAI - with a strong Go-To-Market (GTM) focus. The candidate in the role will define and drive the AI GTM strategy, build differentiated solution narratives and value propositions, and develop industry-specific solutions and use cases across Financial Services; Consumer, Products and Retail; Healthcare and Wellness; Manufacturing; Supply Chain; Telecom; Real Estate; and other sectors. A central part of the role is scaling AI/GenAI capabilities through business development, thought leadership, and talent development.
  
  
Your key responsibilities
  
  

* Define and execute the AI/GenAI Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy in alignment with business priorities and identify high-value AI transformation opportunities across functions and industries.
* Drive business development by originating new client opportunities, leading proposal development, and actively participating in pitches for existing and prospective accounts.
* Own executive-level client relationships by serving as a trusted advisor, ensuring delivery excellence, and identifying opportunities to expand client impact.
* Build AI solution narratives, value propositions, and differentiated messaging, and develop industry-specific AI use cases and business cases.
* Develop and commercialize thought leadership on emerging trends, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, autonomous workflows, and AI-powered analytics.
* Build reusable AI/GenAI intellectual property (IP), including proprietary frameworks, accelerators, and new offerings that differentiate EY's capabilities in the market.
* Develop, review, and implement solutions using AI, machine learning, and deep learning, and develop APIs using Python.
* Lead the development and implementation of Generative AI applications using open-source models (Llama, BERT, Mistral, etc.) and closed-source models (OpenAI GPT models, Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services, Claude, Cohere, etc.).
* Design and optimize solutions that leverage vector databases for efficient storage and retrieval of contextual data for LLMs.
* Understand business priorities and sector dynamics, and identify white spaces and opportunities for analytics and AI applications.
* Manage large and mid-sized projects, ensure smooth service delivery across assigned products, engagements and/or geographies, and work with project managers to address resource needs and gaps.
* Coach and mentor managers and junior colleagues, investing in the growth of EY's AI/GenAI talent and team culture.
* Collaborate across D&A and adjacent practices to bring integrated, high-impact AI solutions to clients' most complex challenges, and provide expert review across projects.

Skills and attributes for success
  
  

* AI & Data fluent: Strong understanding of AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, and data and analytics, with the ability to integrate data, AI/GenAI platforms, and analytics into large-scale enterprise transformations and articulate a clear point of view on the evolving agentic AI landscape.
* A proven business developer: Experienced in consulting, solutioning, pre-sales, product strategy, or technology GTM, including managing proposal processes, leading client pitches, growing accounts, and identifying and pursuing new opportunities.
* A leader and collaborator: Energized by managing high-performing cross-functional teams and building trusted, long-term relationships with senior client stakeholders.
* A structured thinker: Able to navigate ambiguity, decompose complex business and technology challenges, and deliver clear, actionable solutions with executive-level communication.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
* Ability to work creatively and systematically in a time-limited, problem-solving environment.
* Reliable and ethical, with high professional standards.
* Flexible, curious, and creative, with openness to new ideas and the ability to propose innovative solutions.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a positive, collaborative working style.
* Intercultural intelligence and experience working across multicultural, distributed-delivery teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and drive projects to completion with minimal supervision.

To qualify for the role, you must have
  
  

* MBA or master's degree in Business, Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
* 11-14 years of relevant work experience in developing and implementing AI and machine learning solutions; deployment experience in Azure is preferred.
* Proven experience in AI transformation programs, with a track record of pipeline generation, proposal development, and deal support.
* Experience building and commercializing AI/GenAI offerings, assets, or IP.
* Exposure to enterprise architecture, data governance, and automation platforms.
* Experience guiding teams on AI/Data Science projects and communicating results to clients.
* Familiarity with implementing solutions in the Azure cloud framework.
* Experience applying statistical techniques such as linear and non-linear regression, classification, optimization, forecasting, and text analytics.
* Familiarity with deep learning and machine learning algorithms and popular AI/ML frameworks.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience working with NLG, LLM, and deep learning techniques, including neural network approaches.
* Expertise in implementing applications using open-source and proprietary LLM models, and proficiency with LangChain-type orchestrators or similar Generative AI workflow management tools.
* Minimum of 6-9 years of programming experience in Python.
* Experience with the software development life cycle (SDLC) and principles of product development.
* Excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to mentor team members, with strong technical and problem-solving skills.

Ideally, you’ll also have
  
  

* Ability to think strategically and end-to-end, with a result-oriented mindset.
* Ability to build rapport within the firm and earn client trust.
* Willingness to travel extensively and work from client sites and/or practice office locations.

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn in this fast-moving environment.
* An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multidisciplinary team of 3,000+ professionals in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Parthenon practices globally and with leading businesses across a range of industries.

What we offer
  
  
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in delivering EY's growth strategy. From accountants and coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities across business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from around the world. We will introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

title: Engineer
description:
**Job title: Engineer - Aftermarket Sales**
**Location: Bangalore**
**About Us**
Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Aftermarket Sales Engineer for Power Tools and Industrial Lifting is responsible for maximizing lifecycle value of customer assets through preventive maintenance, OEM spare parts, repairs, refurbishment, modernization, and long-term service agreements. By leveraging Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles, the role helps customers improve safety, reliability, and productivity while reducing downtime and overall operating costs, thereby driving sustainable aftermarket growth and recurring revenue for the business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Maintain a comprehensive database of installed power tools and industrial lifting equipment within the assigned territory.
* Build strong relationships with Customer manufacturing engineering, Production engineering , purchase, project and maintenance teams.
* Conduct regular customer visits to understand equipment utilization, maintenance practices, and operational challenges.
* Identify aftermarket opportunities across the entire equipment lifecycle.
* Promote preventive maintenance programs to increase equipment availability and reliability.
* Analyze equipment operating hours, service history, usage patterns, and failure trends.
* Recommend replacement of wear parts before failure occurs.
* Drive sales of preventive maintenance kits and scheduled replacement components.
* Convert inspection findings into spare parts and service orders.
* Educate customers on the financial benefits of planned maintenance versus breakdown repairs.
* Act as a trusted advisor by helping customers understand lifecycle costs associated with equipment ownership.
* Demonstrate how preventive maintenance can reduce:
* Unplanned downtime
* Emergency repair costs
* Production losses
* Overtime maintenance expenses
* Safety incidents
* Equipment replacement costs

**Develop Business Cases Comparing**

* Preventive maintenance vs. corrective maintenance
* OEM parts vs. non-genuine parts
* Repair vs. replacement decisions
* Planned shutdown maintenance vs. emergency breakdown repairs

**Position Services And Parts As Tools To**

* Extend asset life
* Reduce maintenance expenditure
* Enhance productivity
* Improve equipment availability
* Improve return on asset investment
* Conduct equipment condition assessments and site surveys.
* Perform health checks for lifting equipment and power tools.
* Identify worn-out or safety-critical components.
* Generate inspection reports with maintenance recommendations.
* Develop commercial proposals based on audit findings.
* Support customers in complying with safety and statutory inspection requirements.
* Identify opportunities for equipment refurbishment and rebuild projects.
* Promote overhaul programs to restore equipment performance.
* Recommend repair solutions based on equipment condition.
* Provide customers with cost-benefit analysis of repair versus replacement.
* Coordinate repair activities with service centers and field teams.

**Promote And Secure**

* Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
* Preventive Maintenance Agreements
* Inspection Contracts
* Calibration Services
* Repair and Overhaul Agreements

**Responsibilities Include**

* Contract renewals
* Contract profitability
* Multi-year service agreements
* Expansion of service coverage across customer sites
* Prepare technical and commercial quotations.
* Coordinate with service, operations, procurement, and supply chain teams.
* Ensure competitive pricing while maintaining profitability.
* Negotiate contracts and service agreements.
* Follow up quotations and improve order conversion rates.
* Monitor open opportunities through CRM systems.

**Achieve Targets For**

* Spare parts sales
* Service revenue
* Repair revenue
* AMC revenue
* Refurbishment projects
* Upgrade projects
* Improve aftermarket attachment rates.
* Increase recurring revenue through long-term service agreements.
* Manage profitability and gross margin performance.
* Drive sustainable growth within the installed base.

**Collaborate Closely With**

* Service Engineers
* Service Managers
* Product Specialists
* Supply Chain Teams
* Repair Centers
* Operations Teams
* Sales Teams
* Customer Maintenance Teams
* Map key customer assets and maintenance cycles.
* Develop account-specific aftermarket strategies.
* Identify high-revenue lifecycle opportunities.
* Track competitor activities and market trends.
* Position the company as a lifecycle reliability partner rather than simply a spare parts supplier.

**Requirements**

* Qualitification can be BE in Mechatronics, Mechanical or Electrical, MBA an added advantage
* 5-7 years in handling customers

**Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements**

* Leave Encashments

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
  
  
We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices, using the state-of-the-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
  
  
But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
  
  
If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy & Transactions is your next move.
  
  
**The team**

* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.

Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
  
  
**Work you will do:**
Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
  
  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go-to-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.

**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**

* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* - Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI-powered features end-to-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.

**Core Consulting**

* Clear and concise communication - conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking - Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI-enabled digital transformation, data & AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.

**Preferred:**

* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**

title: Brand Solutions Manager
description:
**About Us**

Barcode Entertainment is a leading influencer marketing agency, known for collaborating with premium brands and creators to deliver creative campaigns. Now part of Ykone group, a global influencer marketing network, we are expanding our reach both nationally and internationally and redefining what brand-creator partnerships can achieve at scale.

**About the role**

We're looking for a sharp, proactive Brand Solutions Manager who leads with thinking and follows through with action. This is not a role for someone who waits for briefs. You will identify brands worth going after, find the gap or opportunity in their current marketing, build a compelling insight-led strategy around it. And then use that strategy to open the doors. The pitch is your introduction. The relationship is what you build from there.

If you're someone who reads a brand's campaign, immediately spots what's missing, and knows exactly what to tell the brand team to get a meeting, this role is for you.

**What you'll do**

***Primary - Identify & Strategise***

* Continuously scan the market to identify brands actively investing in influencer marketing in India
* Analyse their current marketing approach and identify gaps, whitespaces, or untapped opportunities
* Build sharp, insight-led influencer marketing strategies tailored to the brand unprompted, before any brief exists
* Stay deeply plugged into platform trends, creator culture, and pop culture to keep pitches relevant and timely

***Secondary - Outreach & open doors***

* Use your strategy as the hook to reach out to brand decision-makers. (Marketing heads, CMOs, founders, brand managers)
* Initiate conversations via LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, calls, events, and your own network
* Pitch with confidence, handle objections, and convert initial interest into a defined brief or meeting
* Collaborate with internal strategy, creative, and influencer teams to develop the full campaign proposal
* Manage the conversation through to closure, ensuring alignment between client expectations and delivery

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of experience in brand solutions, business development, or partnerships, ideally within influencer marketing, digital marketing, or a creative agency
* A strategic thinker who can spot a brand opportunity before the brand does
* Strong understanding of Instagram, YouTube (TikTok is a plus), and the broader creator economy in India
* Excellent written and verbal communication, you can write a cold email or LinkedIn message that actually gets a reply
* Comfortable initiating conversations with senior decision-makers without a warm introduction
* Highly organised, self-directed, and comfortable working without a playbook
* Genuine passion for brands, culture, and the influencer space

**The one thing that matters most**

You should be able to look at a brand, identify what's missing in their influencer marketing, build a strategy around it, and get in front of the right person at the brand team.

All before anyone asks you to.

If that sounds like how you already think, we'd like to meet you.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer GTM
description:
**About TrueFoundry**
Every production AI system whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions needs the same foundational infrastructure.A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
  
  
**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.**
We are looking for a Solution Architect
  
  
**The Problem We're Solving**
Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
  
  
The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready.
  
  
**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**

* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agents

**AI Gateway**
is the control plane five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
  
  
We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical arc of the deal: discovery and the in-depth demo, the architecture discussion with the customer's engineering leaders, and the POC - all the way through to close.
* Win the POC on technical merit: Co-define the success criteria with the customer, run the execution tracker and the milestones, and write the integration glue, agent workflows, and eval pipelines that prove value in their environment. The goal is delivered impact, not lines of code.
* Make the architecture calls that decide how the customer will run AI in production. You are the technical decision-maker in the room - the CTO in the room - and the person their engineering leaders trust.
* Be the technical face of TrueFoundry to enterprise customers, and earn the credibility that turns an evaluation into a signed contract.
* Steer the product. You see, first-hand, what customers pull toward and where their first production win lands. Compile that field signal and bring structured, data-backed asks to TrueFoundry's engineering and product teams - your intuition helps shape the roadmap.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Backend Engineering Experience: 3 to 7 years of backend software engineering experience with production systems you have shipped and owned. Strong in Python, Go, or TypeScript. Comfortable with Kubernetes or any major cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Business Acumen: You don’t just question the how but also the why - discovering impact, architecture design and deal-winning opportunities.
* AI and ML literacy: You have worked with LLMs, agents, evals, or ML pipelines in production. Familiarity with the modern stack (vLLM, SGLang, LangChain, Triton, model serving) is a strong plus.
* Design and Architecture: Comfortable leading an architecture discussion with a customer's engineering leaders, then doing the work yourself. High agency and a bias for action.
* We especially welcome founding engineers and CTOs of early-stage startups, as well as engineers from infrastructure, MLOps, and developer-tool companies.

**Traits we are looking for:**
Ownership, ability to execute, hustle and think out of the box, data-driven decision-making, be comfortable with more unknowns than knowns.
  
  
Perks of Working at TrueFoundry
  
  

* Join a fast-growing Series A, Bay Area-based startup building cutting-edge AI infrastructure.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule.
* Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office.
* Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world, a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences, and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences.
  
  
The Enterprise Technology mission
  
  
is to deliver technology solutions that align to business strategies while enabling enterprise efficiency and promoting cross-company collaborative innovation. Our group drives competitive advantage by enhancing our consumer experiences, enabling business growth, and advancing operational excellence.
  
  
Team Description
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, Citizen Development & AI at Disney Enterprise Tech Collaboration Experiences, you are responsible to drive world-class solution architecture and citizen development practices that empower business users to build intelligent applications using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI. You’ll partner across technology, engineering, product management, and business teams to enable scalable, secure, and transformative AI-powered solutions that enhance collaboration and productivity across the enterprise.
  
  
Responsibilities Of Role
  
  
**Solution Architecture**

* Architect and deliver end-to-end solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Azure AI, integrating with SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive and enterprise systems such using available connectors or creating them.
* Design and deploy custom Copilot agents and AI workflows that automate business processes and enhance productivity for citizen developers and business users.
* Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions.
* Define and implement governance frameworks for agent development, deployment, and lifecycle management, ensuring compliance with enterprise security and data protection standards.
* Evaluate and optimize AI solutions for performance, cost efficiency, and user experience.

Enablement & Community
  
  

* Lead technical workshops, training sessions, and hackathons to enable citizen developers and promote AI literacy across the organization.
* Consult with business stakeholders to gather detailed requirements and collaboratively identify tailored solution pathways that address their needs and drive enterprise transformation.
* Contribute to the AI Community of Practice, sharing best practices and mentoring junior architects and developers.

Must Haves
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in solution architecture, with at least 2 years focused on AI, automation, or low-code platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI services.
* Strong understanding of declarative and custom-engine agent development, orchestration models, and integration with Microsoft Graph and external connectors.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex technical solutions in a fast-paced enterprise environment.
* Familiarity with AI governance, data privacy, and security frameworks.

Nice To Haves
  
  

* Microsoft certifications in Power Platform, Azure AI, or Solution Architecture.
* Experience with citizen development enablement, including training, onboarding, and community building.
* Knowledge of MCP, A2A and Agent Frameworks.
* Knowledge of Copilot Studio reference architectures, adaptive cards, and generative orchestration strategies.
* Prior experience in the media, entertainment, or streaming industry.
* Familiarity with Disney’s technology platforms, data environments, and compliance standards.

Education
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field (Master’s preferred) or equivalent experience.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
  
This position is with Disney (India) Private Limited, which is part of a business we call The Walt Disney Company (Corporate).

title: Application Engineer
description:

Flowserve is a global manufacturer of pumps, valves, seals, and aftermarket services, delivering comprehensive flow control solutions that support essential industries such as energy, clean water, and pharmaceuticals. If you're looking for a culture built on ingenuity, innovation, and excellence, Flowserve offers the opportunity to put your experience in motion. Whether you're an individual contributor or a people leader, you'll find meaningful opportunities for professional growth, competitive rewards, and a workplace grounded in our core values: People, Safety, Integrity, Ownership and Ingenuity. At Flowserve, we're inspired by what we can achieve together—creating extraordinary flow control solutions that strengthen today's world while building tomorrow.
  
  
Role Summary:
  
  
The Sales Support Representative (SSR) is the primary point of contact for the customer and collaborates with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and other departments to respond to customer inquiries. The position works with the Sales leadership team in driving key initiatives and helping the Flowserve to achieve its goals and maximize sales bookings and opportunity pipelines. The SSR will use data as a strategic asset to provide decision support, accurate planning of sales quota forecasting, and sales productivity reporting and efficiency analysis.
  
  
Responsibilities & Requirements:

* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, while ensuring effective communication and collaboration across varying functional/business platforms.
* Promote a positive and professional working atmosphere, where the status quo is challenged to improve, and the team is driven toward creating an exceptional customer experience.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Meet the Team
  
  
The Splunk Agent Resilience team is defining the future of AI resilience. Together our team provides scalable, cost-effective evaluation and guardrails that ensure AI agents behave as intended, improving reliability and reducing risks. This unified approach empowers our customers to expertly deploy and manage AI-powered applications with enhanced observability and control.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation to help some of the world's largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. You'll partner closely with external customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with internal Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will
  
  

* Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
* Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
* Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
* Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of strong software engineering experience building production-grade applications.
* Experience with APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or backend development.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, cursor, etc.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.
* Experience building customer-facing technical solutions or integrations.
* Experience creating reusable developer tools, frameworks, or open-source contributions.
* Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.
* Experience with programming language such as python, Java, etc.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Senior Deployment Engineer
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**Deployment Engineer**
**The Team**
Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Senior Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.
  
  
This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer.
**You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.**
**The Work You’ll Do**
**Initiate and Connect**

* Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases
* Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
* Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

**Build & Value**

* Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
* Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights
* Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
* Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
* Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
* Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

**Rollout, Adoption, and Handover**

* Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption
* Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
* Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
* Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

**Domain & Industry Depth**

* Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
* Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
* Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

**What Makes This Role Different In The AI Era**

* You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
* You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
* You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
* You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
* You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

**The Qualifications You Need**

* Experience: 4+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. For Senior DE: 6+ years with demonstrated project leadership.
* Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
* AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
* Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
* Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.
* Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
* Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
* Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.
* Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
  
  
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Data Solutions Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Senior Data Solutions Consultant,**
you will lead some of Addepar’s complex and high-touch client data implementation projects. You’ll design scalable solutions to transform and integrate clients’ portfolio data into Addepar, consult with clients on sophisticated investment data challenges, and serve as a subject-matter expert across both technical and business domains.
  
  
You’ll also be among the
**first members of the Data Solutions team based in India**
, helping establish our presence in the region while working closely with colleagues across the U.S., U.K., and other global offices. This is a collaborative role offering the opportunity to shape our operating model locally and strengthen how our global teams deliver together.
  
  
Beyond client delivery, you’ll also drive internal innovation; developing automation, tooling, and best practices that enable scale and elevate how we operate globally. This is a senior individual contributor position for someone who thrives at the intersection of finance, data, and technology, and is excited to make a global impact from India.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead complex client implementations: Architect and execute data conversion projects to extract, transform, and load historical portfolio data from clients’ legacy systems into Addepar.
* Design scalable data solutions: Translate unique client requirements into flexible, sustainable workflows that enable accurate reporting and analysis.
* Own a portfolio of high-impact projects: Manage multiple concurrent client engagements, prioritizing effectively and driving each to successful completion.
* Elevate team capability: Build or enhance internal tools, scripts, and frameworks that improve efficiency, data quality, and scalability across the team.
* Consult and collaborate: Serve as a subject-matter expert for investment-related data and partner closely with Services, Sales, Product, and Engineering to deliver tailored client outcomes.
* Mentor and influence: Provide guidance and technical mentorship to peers, contributing to best practices and knowledge-sharing across the Data Solutions function.
* Champion operational excellence: Identify and lead opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve our delivery processes and workflows.

**Who You Are**

* Experienced: Minimum 5+ years of experience in technology, finance, or consulting, with a strong record of leading complex data or financial system integration projects.
* Technical: Experience with Python, with hands-on experience manipulating large datasets, building ETL pipelines, or automating data workflows.
* Investment-Savvy:

+ Deep domain knowledge in investment management, including a strong understanding of diverse asset classes (equities, fixed income, derivatives, alternatives), financial instruments, and portfolio accounting principles.
+ Significant hands-on experience working with investment data sources, including security master files, transaction and pricing data, and market data feeds.

* Client-Focused: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes.
* Solutions-Oriented: Creative problem-solver who operates with ownership and accountability in ambiguous environments.
* Collaborative: Works effectively across teams and functions to deliver measurable impact.
* Process-Minded: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and continuously looking for ways to improve efficiency and scale.
* Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and global stakeholders.
* Preferably someone who has experience in post-sales activities.

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Presales Solutions Engineer
description:
**Title:**
Presales Solutions Engineer

**Work location:**
Bangalore

**Experience range:**
10 to 20 years

**Why WWT?**

World Wide Technology (WWT) strives to make a new world happen. WWT's work benefits clients and partners as much as it does its people and community across the globe.

title: Technical Security Consultant
description:
**WHO ARE WE?**

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

**CloudSEK,**
one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

**CloudSEK’s Product Suite:**

* CloudSEK
  **XVigil**
  constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring
  tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's
  **BeVigil**
  uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* CloudSEK’s Contextual AI
  **SVigil**
  identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

**Key Milestones:**

* **2016**
  : Launched our first product.
* **2018**
  : Secured Pre-series A funding.
* **2019**
  : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* **2020**
  : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* **2021**
  : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* **Awards & Recognition**
  : Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* **2025**
  : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

**About the Role:**

CloudSEK's
**Security Consulting, Threat Research & Intelligence for Key Enablement (STRIKE)**
Division sits at the intersection of threat research, technical consulting, and business growth. STRIKE consultants don't just demo products, they shape how clients understand their threat exposure, build regional intelligence that no one else is producing, and establish CloudSEK as the go-to partner for cyber resilience in their market.

This isn't a traditional sales-support role. It's a high-ownership position for someone who thinks like a researcher, speaks like a strategist, and executes like a founder.

**What You'll Own:**

**Driving Technical Wins-**

You'll lead POC engagements and new business trials end-to-end, from scoping through to outcome delivery. That means going beyond feature demonstrations: you'll map client exposure using CloudSEK's platform, surface real findings, and translate them into a narrative that resonates with both security teams and the C-suite.

* Design and run proof-of-capability engagements that produce verifiable, client-specific intelligence
* Present findings and platform capabilities to CISOs, SOC leads, and business executives with clarity and conviction
* Identify gaps that extend beyond the platform's current scope, and frame their business impact honestly
* Own the feedback loop between client outcomes and internal product and research teams.

**Regional Threat Intelligence**

You'll be CloudSEK's eyes and ears on the Indian threat landscape (South), producing original research, not just curating feeds.

* Track threat actors, campaigns, and infrastructure targeting governments, critical infrastructures, banks, telcos, and enterprises
* Produce intelligence briefs, exposure reports, and RFP-ready content tailored to India sector risks
* Monitor dark web activity, data leak forums, and regional cybercriminal ecosystems relevant to client verticals
* Build and maintain a running view of the India threat landscape that informs both client conversations and internal product direction

**Partner & Client Enablement**

* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, partners, and channel MSSPs across the region
* Enable partner security consultants through co-selling, technical onboarding, and regional SME support
* Collaborate with Sales on pipeline development, renewal strategies, and cross-sell opportunities
* Track account health metrics and communicate progress clearly to internal stakeholders

**Community & Thought Leadership**

* Initiate and drive CloudSEK's community presence in India (South) - conferences, roundtables, online forums, and practitioner networks
* Publish research-led content (threat reports, intelligence summaries, advisory notes) that builds credibility and generates inbound interest
* Represent CloudSEK at regional events, government-led cybersecurity forums, and sector-specific workshops

**Skills Required**

**Must Have**

* 1–4 years of experience in a cybersecurity role - consulting, threat intelligence, pre-sales, security operations, or related fields
* Working knowledge of core cybersecurity concepts - threat intelligence, attack surface management, digital risk, or offensive security
* Clear and confident communicator - able to present technical findings to both technical teams and business stakeholders
* Analytical mindset with the ability to identify patterns, derive insights, and communicate them with precision
* Self-starter who can manage multiple engagements independently in a fast-paced environment

**Nice to Have:**

* Exposure to the India market or familiarity with regional cyber threat trends - a plus, but not a dealbreaker
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted research or automation workflows
* Experience working with or supporting channel partners, MSSPs, or system integrators
* Existing presence in cybersecurity communities - whether through research contributions, conference participation, or online engagement

**Benefits of Joining CloudSEK**

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

* Flexible working hours.
* Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!

CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Strategic Advisor / Consultant – Energy Management & Controls (Renewable Energy)
description:
