title: Solutions Architect, ISV
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Karnataka

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Technical Partnership: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* Joint Solution Development: Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* Customer Deal Support: Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* Partner Ecosystem & Events: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* Product Feedback: Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Technical Service - Agronomy, Plant Biosolutions - India
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis Plant Biosolutions, we believe biology can help transform agriculture and create a more sustainable future. We are looking for an experienced agronomy professional to help accelerate the adoption of biological solutions across India by connecting science, farmers, partners, and commercial teams.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service – Agronomy, Plant Biosolutions - South Asia, you will be a trusted technical and agronomy expert for Novonesis Plant Biosolutions in India. You will drive the adoption and growth of biological solutions in sugarcane through strategic engagement with sugar mills, distributors, and commercial teams.
  
  
You will provide technical leadership, validate product performance, develop agronomic value propositions, and help successfully commercialize Novonesis Biosolutions across key sugarcane-growing regions in India.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Partner closely with sugar mills in Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Karnataka to accelerate adoption and commercialization of Novonesis Biosolutions in sugarcane.
* Build strong relationships with sugar mill management, agronomy teams, and their extension networks, while supporting commercial teams in communicating Novonesis' technical value proposition and product differentiation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert in sugarcane agronomy and biological solutions, developing agronomic recommendations, application protocols, and best practices for Novonesis products.
* Establish and manage demonstration programs, field days, customer trials, and a robust pipeline of demonstrations supporting current and future business opportunities.
* Develop technical evidence and content, including comparative field data, cost calculators, case studies, customer testimonials, success stories, and agronomic recommendations.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting and deliver technical training to sugar mill agronomy and commercial teams and distributors.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Agronomy, Soil Science, Plant Nutrition, Crop Science, Agricultural Microbiology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in agronomy, technical services, or market development with sugar mills or within the agri-inputs, crop nutrition, crop protection, or agri-biologicals industry.
* Strong agronomic expertise in sugarcane production systems and crop management practices.
* Demonstrated experience conducting field trials, demonstration programs, technical evaluations, and data interpretation.
* Experience working directly with farmers, distributors, institutional customers, or large sugar mill groups.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with fluency in English and Hindi.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* A customer-centric approach and passion for agriculture.
* A self-driven, entrepreneurial approach and ability to work independently.
* Strong collaboration and cross-functional working skills.
* A strong execution mindset, curiosity, and forward-thinking approach.
* Business acumen and the ability to translate agronomic science into customer and commercial value.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to bring your sugarcane agronomy expertise together with biological solutions and work across science, agriculture, customer partnerships, and commercial teams. The role offers broad engagement with sugar mills, distributors, farmers, and internal teams while contributing to the growth of Plant Biosolutions in India.
  
  
Working conditions
  
  
This is a hybrid role based in NCR, New Delhi or Bangalore, with travel of up to 60% within India.
  
  
Application deadline
  
  
End of October.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

title: AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.
* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Senior Technical Consultant: Salesforce(Automotive Experience)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Executive Summary & Organizational Context**
Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
* Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
* Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
* Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
* Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.

While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.
  
  

* Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.

**Target Certification Requirements**
Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

*Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.*
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.
  
  

* Leadership Qualities & Core Values To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Senior Technical Consultant must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust. Core Leadership Pillars
* PASSION: Demonstrates an unyielding commitment to Customer Success. The consultant exhibits deep personal investment in seeing automotive clients succeed, transforming complex technology implementations into tangible market wins and measurable business outcomes for OEM stakeholders and dealer networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Maintains a continuous learning mindset. The consultant approaches every complex enterprise engagement, client interaction, and architectural challenge with humbleness, curiosity, and openness—actively dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in automotive technology and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives amidst high levels of uncertainty and rapid industry transformation. Recognizing that structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption are permanent constants in the automotive sector, the consultant remains poised, agile, and decisive when navigating ambiguous project environments.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Manager, Account Management
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Account Management
  
  
Mastercard is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented professional to join the Financial Institutions (FI) team. This individual contributor role will be responsible for managing and growing strategic relationships with Banks and Financial Institutions while identifying new business opportunities that drive revenue growth and expand Mastercard's presence within the banking ecosystem.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted partner to customers, developing deep stakeholder relationships, uncovering opportunities for collaboration, and delivering innovative payment solutions that create mutual value. The role requires a combination of relationship management, business development, strategic thinking, and commercial execution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own and manage relationships with a portfolio of Banks and Financial Institutions, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to strengthen existing client relationships, increase customer engagement, and drive sustainable business growth.
* Identify opportunities within existing customer portfolios to expand Mastercard's products, services, and solutions, generating incremental revenue and increasing market share.
* Proactively scout for and secure new business opportunities with existing and prospective banking partners to achieve business development objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers, including CXOs, Business Heads, Product Heads, Payments Heads, Cards Leaders, and Digital Banking stakeholders.
* Work closely with customers to understand their strategic priorities and align Mastercard solutions to support their growth ambitions.
* Lead customer engagements and business discussions to identify opportunities across card issuance, digital payments, acceptance, commercial solutions, value-added services, and emerging payment technologies.
* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new and existing Mastercard products and solutions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Franchise, Customer Solutions, Consulting, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver customer-centric solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Analyse customer portfolios, market trends, competitive dynamics, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities and formulate winning strategies.
* Prepare business cases, commercial proposals, and account growth plans to support customer acquisition and portfolio expansion.
* Lead and support commercial negotiations, partnership discussions, and contract renewals to maximize customer value and business outcomes.
* Track account performance, pipeline opportunities, revenue contribution, and execution against business targets.
* Drive assigned strategic initiatives and projects from concept through implementation, ensuring successful execution and measurable business impact.

**About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.
* Experience in Relationship Management, Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or Product Management within the Banking, Payments, Cards, Fintech, or broader BFSI sector.
* Demonstrated experience managing relationships with Banks and Financial Institutions.
* Proven ability to strengthen existing customer relationships and identify new opportunities that drive incremental revenue growth.
* Strong track record of delivering revenue targets, portfolio growth, and market expansion.
* Deep understanding of the payment’s ecosystem, including cards, digital payments, issuing, acquiring, and banking products.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience developing business cases, commercial proposals, and partnership strategies.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage and influence senior decision makers both internally and externally.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable business opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated leadership through influence and collaboration across cross-functional teams.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Business Processes Principal Consultant - CIS
description:

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
  
  
**Business Process Principal Consultant — Customer Industry Solutions (CIS)**
**What You Will Do**

* Lead customer innovation engagements: Run discovery workshops and FDE-style boot camps with business and IT stakeholders to surface, qualify, and prioritize Industry AI opportunities capable of fundamentally transforming how customers operate and grow.
* Define high-value Industry AI use cases: Translate business challenges into implementable AI solutions — applying AI tools in the definition process itself to sharpen requirements, agent architecture, KPIs, and quantified value metrics.
* Own the end-to-end lifecycle: Drive use cases from discovery to deployment — defining requirements, building prototypes and acceptance criteria, partnering with engineering throughout, and validating business outcomes.
* Deliver value rapidly: Apply a fast, iterative model that puts measurable customer value in production within weeks, not quarters.
* Build the Industry AI portfolio: Turn customer learnings into industry-specific AI assets and accelerators — with documented financial and operational value, reusable across SAP globally.

**What You Bring**

* Deep industry expertise: 6+ years in Manufacturing, Energy & Natural Resources, Consumer Products, or Professional Industries — with operational-level knowledge of where processes break and where transformation creates real value.
* AI use case expertise: Hands-on experience defining Agentic AI solutions with a clear focus on data readiness, process fit, and measurable outcomes.
* Product Management or consulting excellence: Proven track record in product definition and delivery, or in leading business transformation initiatives — translating complex challenges into structured programs that deliver at the senior stakeholder level.
* Customer engagement and emotional intelligence: Demonstrated ability to lead executive workshops, FDE-style discovery sessions, and co-innovation engagements — navigating complex organizational dynamics with emotional intelligence and building trust at every level.
* Strategic thinking and complex problem solving: Ability to cut through ambiguity, identify the highest-impact AI opportunities, and chart a clear path from complex business challenge to executable solution.
* Business acumen and value orientation: Ability to translate AI opportunities into quantified business cases — with realistic KPIs, ROI timelines, and a clear understanding of how value is created and measured in the businesses you serve.
* SAP platform knowledge: Strong working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business AI Platform, SAP Joule, Signavio, LeanIX, and clean-core, cloud-first architecture principles.
* Communication and influencing skills: Clear, concise English — written and verbal — able to produce sharp requirements documentation, lead executive-level discussions, and influence diverse stakeholders toward a shared direction.

**Where You Belong**
You will join SAP's Customer Industry Solutions (CIS) team — a global group of industry experts at the intersection of deep domain knowledge and cutting-edge AI engineering. The role demands both rare domain depth and the ability to influence engineering teams, product managers, and customer executives. Guiding others to define sharper use cases, ask better value questions, and close the gap between AI potential and business reality is an explicit expectation at this level.
  
  
**Bring out your best**
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
  
  
**We win with inclusion**
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

description:

Client satisfaction across projects managed by the company. Overseeing, managing and delivering technical projects on time and to a high quality, to the delight of clients.

**Description of the Role:**

Our vision as a company is to be world leading at finding and designing new wind farm sites. We are building a set of tools, approaches and engineering processes that will, in time, combine to form a capability to undertake the technical management of wind farm development at a significantly improved level of sophistication over existing standard industry approaches.

To achieve its aim, Wind Pioneers is driven by its consultancy work, both in terms of providing the revenues for our continued existence, but also to provide a rich source of learning opportunities to help test and develop our approaches.

Growing a cohort of satisfied clients is key to the company achieving its long-term aim, and the
**Engineering Lead**
for Wind Pioneers

**Detailed Responsibilities**

The role will broadly involve:

1. Client handling from enquiry to final project delivery. Running business meetings along with Client Leads with clients across regions and understanding the scope of work and striking a deal.
2. Undertaking engineering assessments, and working with project engineers to ensure the quality of project deliverables.
3. Providing advice to clients to help them progress technical aspects of their projects
4. Keep existing clients happy by making sure our assessments for them are in line with their expectations.
5. Acting as a single point of contact for various Clients, including key Clients.
6. Identifying new clients and growing the business across the world.
7. Work closely on client feedback to improve overall delivery of projects.
8. Provide valuable guidance to the team for better management of clients and projects.
9. Close collaboration

   with

   Client Leads for job resourcing across various projects.
10. Closely collaborate with Technical Lead for project management and commercial support

11. Mentoring    and    training    of   team    members, and coordination of cross-pollination of knowledge and ideas across the team

**Candidate Requirements:**

* A passion for wind resource, and for the role renewable energy can play in mitigating climate change
* 7+ years of experience in the field and in a similar role. Also capable of independent work, and taking initiative in self- directing work projects
* Highly organised
* Detail orientated
* Confident communicator
* Great in a client-facing role and technically sound
* Able to build rapport with team and clients
* Takes great pride in quality of their work
* Always looking to improve processes, approaches
* Potential to grow with the company

**Wind Pioneers’ Offering:**

* Responsibility in owning many aspects of Wind Pioneers’ consultancy activities
* Supportive environment to gain in-depth technical experience the Wind Pioneers way
* Part of a focused team with a clear vision, dedicated to making an outsized impact in the way that wind farm projects are found and evaluated
* A friendly, relaxed office environment and team culture
* Flexible working conditions
* Market-based salary along with addition of Wind Pioneers’ revenue share scheme

Drives adoption through to cross-sell/upsell to new opportunities. Stays up to date on Microsoft offers and solutions. Uses knowledge to engage with customers and with internal teams.

Account Management
  
  
Strategically identifies and qualifies business opportunities, leading them through the sales lifecycle to maximize customer engagement. Drives improvements in pipeline accuracy and hygiene by expertly applying common sales and delivery methodology for the Microsoft sales organization (e.g., MCEM) criteria for qualifying and progressing sales prospects. Advocates for Microsoft solutions to customer by articulating value and strategically promoting upsell/cross-sell opportunities. Orchestrates customer strategy development, leading the creation of sales strategies to achieve customer goals, and presents sophisticated Microsoft solutions in high-stakes deals. Collaborates with customer leaders and stakeholders to thoroughly analyze budget considerations and decisively align strategic priorities for investment with a significant impact on business outcomes.
  
  
Strategically manages and proactively leads renewals and anniversaries for both enterprise agreement (EA) and cloud solution provider (CSP), with a focus on maximizing customer engagement and satisfaction. Develops tailored renewal options that align with partners and customer business outcomes and licensing vehicle and supports others in the renewal process. Seeks out opportunities to consolidate and drives cross- and upsells that are closely integrated with customer priorities and predicted outcomes. Establishes and refines the process for forecasting and timing renewals to optimize growth, consumption, and on-time renewals. Conceives and implements strategic actions for T-minus plans with a focus on sustainable impact. Provides expertise on available licensing SKUs and programs and advises on how they can be leveraged to meet complex customer needs. Implements and drives negotiation strategies and stakeholder maps. Takes lead in driving conversations with appropriate parties and collaborates with partners to scale and maximize resources effectively. Collaborates with partners to ensure right outcome(s) for the customer. Works with customers and partners to drive assessments and deep dives into customer environments. Understands and leverages investments in best possible way during renewal process. Conducts in-depth assessments into customer environments to understand needs and coordinates and implements resources and internal partners (e.g., commercial executives) to drive growth and consumption targets.
  
  
Leads the strategic prioritization of accounts within the portfolio. Directs cross-functional resources and orchestrates development and execution against prioritization. Utilizes a deep understanding of relevant data (e.g., individual customer plan, analysis, available resources/programs) to devise and execute strategic plans that exceed quota for the upcoming year. Ensures a holistic and strategic integration of plans across consumption, upsell, and renewal. Optimizes investment programs to maximize impact across customers and identifies new ways to go-to-market. Provides strategic recommendations for sales plays and identifies key partners to drive new business and pipeline creation. Coaches others to identify and address gaps in territory strategy. Drives engagement cadence during the development of success plans for unified support and consumption plans for MACC customers, in partnership with customer success (e.g., CSAM) teams. Creates co-sell campaigns with partner(s) to align portfolio planning with broader business objectives. Enables partners in their go-to-market strategies. Demonstrates subject matter expertise of industry knowledge to enhance strategic planning and close territory gaps or new-to-role territories. Enforces accountability for deliverables within agreed-upon time frames among self and team members.
  
  
Leads strategic collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to meet and exceed revenue targets and critical deadlines. Orchestrates strategic alignment of teams and resources with customer needs to maximize experience. Provides key organizational insights and ensures alignment of virtual teams with significant opportunities. Mentors others in orchestration and serves as escalation point to resolve collaboration needs. Utilizes and expands a broad network within and across partner ecosystem and resources to drive optimal account performance across solution areas and programs. Identifies resources (e.g., v-team orchestration) and partner solutions to help customers derive value from existing Microsoft investments.
  
  
Customer Engagement
  
  
Leads in-depth analysis of customer satisfaction metrics (e.g., timeliness and quality of contact) and develops and implements comprehensive strategies to address identified trends. Acts as a trusted advisor and resource for others on advanced customer satisfaction strategy and best practices. Strategically oversees primary contact and ensures comprehensive feedback is gathered from appropriate contact, inputs information into applicable database(s), and incorporated from a broad range of sources, including cross-functional teams. Serves as an escalation contact for customer dissatisfaction and designs and implements effective resolutions promptly (e.g., prioritization, escalation). Serves as a point of contact for complex customer issues and ensures responses to customers are completed in a timely manner. Manages the escalation process and strategically engages Microsoft executives to enhance impact. Drives initiatives to anticipate and preemptively address potential customer issues, tailoring requirements to solutions to maximize satisfaction and streamline experiences. Initiates and negotiates conditions of satisfaction with customers at outset of engagement for strategic accounts.
  
  
Strategically orchestrates customer engagements, ensuring alignment of resources across broader teams (e.g., pod members, partners, virtual teams, cross-functional teams), and mentoring team members on fostering strong customer relationships and engagement strategies. Applies advanced synthesis of customer interactions to enhance strategic impact and effectiveness within the organization. Strengthens and expands relationships with key customers and implements advanced tiered approaches to the cadence of customer engagements across multiple lines of business. Acts as a senior advocate and trusted advisor for the customer and influences internal strategies by providing insights from customer perspectives. Leads the utilization and refinement of customer relationship management tools (e.g., MSX D365) to optimize client relationship development. Initiates and leads proactive outreach to engage with customers through innovative digital channels (e.g., social selling, podcasts, webinars), setting benchmarks for digital engagement.
  
  
Captures, assesses, and interprets key learnings internally and externally about customers, coaching team on senior leader engagements and relevancy to board-level approvals. Develops and adapts deep understanding of customer business to lead industry conversations and drive strategic business discussions (e.g., ROI, market trends). Aligns customer business needs and priorities with Microsoft priorities and broad business strategy. Demonstrates recognized expertise across applicable industry and constructs and presents tailored use cases to customers, proactively anticipating their needs and providing foresight into industry trends.

Strategically builds and leverages a deep knowledge of Microsoft's landscape, solutions, and strategy within the industry of assigned accounts, as well as a thorough comprehension of the business priorities. Provides Microsoft point of view on Microsoft solutions and appropriate industry trends and use cases. Exhibits an expert-level understanding of the strategic customers' business strategy and appropriate industry trends and use cases. Completes required training and certifications. Constructs and executes a comprehensive personal development plan with long-term career objectives.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Marketing (or equivalent) or related field AND 6+ years sales and negotiation experience or related work experience OR 8+ years sales and negotiation experience OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor's Degree in Business Management, Information Technology, Marketing (or equivalent) or related field AND 12+ years sales and negotiation experience or related work experience OR 14+ years software industry sales and negotiation experience OR equivalent experience.

description:

At NVIDIA, we are leading the AI computing revolution, crafting innovative deep learning solutions that are transforming industries globally. As a member of our team, you will play a vital role in introducing our groundbreaking GPU products to various deployments, from data centers to edge computing. **Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* 8+ years of working experience in crafting systems / FAE Role.
* In-depth understanding of CPU, GPU and server Baseboard Designs.
* Experience with ARM and NVIDIA GPU development.
* Track record of driving design wins or qualifications at OEMs or CSPs
* Direct experience working with HGX, DGX, or MGX platform designs

— an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform,
**“Observance”**

, uses LiDAR scanning, thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as-built intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.


 

 

**The Role:**

 

We are looking for an articulate, proactive Presales Executive with a civil engineering background to drive lead generation and prospect engagement at Inkers. You will be the first voice of Inkers to our prospects: generating leads, following up consistently, understanding what prospects need, and scheduling discovery calls with our Account Managers. You will also represent Inkers at construction-tech summits, trade shows and exhibitions, where many of our best prospects are found. This is a growth role, and with strong performance you will move into an Account Manager position.
 

**Key Responsibilities:**

 

***Lead Generation & Follow-ups***

 

* Generate new leads through outbound calls, emails, LinkedIn and other channels, targeting developers, contractors, EPC firms, PMC and consulting companies.
* Screen and qualify incoming enquiries and event leads against defined criteria.
* Follow up with prospects consistently and on time until they are ready for a sales conversation or are disqualified.

***Prospect Engagement & Call Scheduling***

 

* Speak with prospects to introduce Inkers and Observance, and understand their project needs and challenges.
* Schedule and confirm discovery and demo calls between prospects and Account Managers.
* Brief Account Managers with prospect background and requirements before every call.
* Research prospects and companies to enrich lead data.

***Events & Industry Presence***

 

* Participate in construction-tech summits, trade shows, exhibitions and webinars; engage visitors and capture leads.
* Coordinate event preparation with the team and run structured post-event follow-ups.
* Be willing to travel for events when required.

***Database, Reporting & Sales Support***

 

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of leads and conversations in the CRM and sales database.
* Track and report key metrics: calls made, conversations held, meetings scheduled and lead conversion.
* Support the sales team with documentation, presentations and proposals when required.

**Qualifications:**

 

* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Civil Engineering; an MBA is an added advantage.
* Excellent spoken and written communication in English; confident on calls and in face-to-face conversations. Knowledge of Hindi or Kannada is an advantage.
* Prior experience in presales, inside sales, business development or lead generation is preferred; strong freshers are welcome.
* Good understanding of construction processes and project lifecycle; awareness of BIM or construction technology is a plus.
* Comfortable with cold calling and persistent follow-ups; self-motivated, organised and target-driven.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.
* Keen to build a career in B2B technology sales and grow into an Account Manager role.

**Career Growth:**

 

Presales Executive to Account Manager, based on performance and demonstrated ownership of the prospect journey.
 

**What We Offer:**

 

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects in the construction technology sector.
* A defined growth path from Presales to Account Manager.
* Exposure to industry events, summits and senior decision-makers in construction.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Access to the latest scanning and modeling technologies.

**Work Location: Bangalore (On-site), with occasional travel to events**

description:

**Role Title:**

**Location:**
Chennai, Bangalore or Mumbai, India
  
  
**Department:**
Regional Sales Support

Sales Director APAC
  
  
**Summary Of Role**
We are seeking a highly detail-oriented, commercially minded, and technically proficient Regional RFQ Specialist to join our team at the Chennai Systems Engineering Centre (SEC). In this role, you will act as the dedicated expert on our Solution Engineering Centre capabilities, supporting regional RFQs and preparing technical/commercial proposals for Asia-based sales teams and customers. You will serve as the crucial technical interface between regional sales organizations, engineering, and production—analyzing complex customer specifications, developing competitive cost estimates, and designing hazardous area/explosion-protected electro-mechanical and LV panel solutions to drive regional business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Tasks**

* Regional Proposal & RFQ Management (Asia Region)
* Act as the central 2nd level technical support interface for the Asia-wide sales network and regional sales organizations.
* Prepare accurate, competitive, and timely cost estimates, technical proposals, and formal RFQ submissions for explosion-protected electro-mechanical solutions and LV electrical panels.
* Ensure all quotations and RFQs are completed accurately and submitted within agreed timelines and regional KPI targets.
* Technical Analysis & Solution Design
* Review and technically qualify customer specifications, Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, and international standards.
* Select suitable electrical components, switchgear, and enclosure configurations tailored to specific customer/project requirements in explosive gas or dust environments.
* Develop basic general arrangement (GA) drawings, preliminary solution designs, and detailed Bills of Materials (BOMs) for junction boxes, motor starter panels, and LV panel solutions.
* Perform technical feasibility studies and calculations to support customer quotations.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Interface
* Collaborate closely with Regional Sales, Local Engineering, R&D, Product Management, and Production teams to ensure technical and commercial compliance.
* Support regional sales teams in pricing strategies, price-finding situations, and technical query resolution.
* Directly (or via regional sales teams) interact with Asia-based clients to clarify technical requirements and present engineered proposals.

**Role Requirements & Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree, or B.Tech in Electrical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering.
* Experience:
* 5+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales support, electrical panel design, estimation, or costing.
* Prior experience in a 2nd-level technical sales support or pre-sales engineering role for control, instrumentation, or electro-mechanical products is highly preferred.

**Technical Skills & Knowledge**

* Hazardous Area Knowledge: Familiarity with explosion-protected equipment (Ex-d, Ex-e, etc.) and global standards (e.g., IECEx, ATEX) for explosive gas or dust atmospheres.
* Electrical & Mechanical Literacy: Strong ability to read, interpret, and analyze wiring schematics, mechanical drawings, technical specifications, and single-line diagrams (SLDs).
* Product Expertise: Deep understanding of Low Voltage (LV) electrical panels, motor starter panels, switchgear, and junction box configurations.
* Software Proficiency:
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word).
* Knowledge of AutoCAD / 2D Electro-CAD tools or ERP systems is a strong advantage.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Communication: Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; comfortable acting as a regional bridge between engineering and international sales offices.
* Commercial Acumen: Ability to balance technical compliance with cost-effective engineering.
* Detail-Oriented & Organized: Proven ability to manage multiple regional queries simultaneously under tight deadlines.

title: Global Bid and Proposal Specialist (UPS)
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
Global Bid and Proposal Manager
  
  
  
  
  
  
**What We Believe In**
At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.
  
  
**Your role and responsibilities:**
In this role, you will be responsible for developing technical and commercial proposals primarily for Low Voltage Uninterruptible Power Supply (LV UPS) systems on a global scale. While the primary focus is LV UPS solutions, the scope may also extend to other Critical Power products and integrated power infrastructure solutions. The ideal candidate will possess a solid technical understanding of ABB’s Critical Power portfolio and the ability to translate customer requirements into commercially viable and technically optimized solutions.
  
  
The work model for the role is:
  
  
The role will support for the Electrification Smart Power Business, Critical Power Product Group to be based at PEENYA Bangalore, India.
  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Oversee technical and commercial tender preparation, risk assessments, and proposal management to ensure timely submissions, market competitiveness, and meeting ABB’s profitability targets.
* Design and develop LV UPS solutions for global customers across data centers, semiconductor facilities, and other mission-critical applications, ensuring reliability and compliance with customer specifications.
* Contribute to business development through technical presentations, customer workshops, product demonstrations, seminars, and solution-based promotional activities targeting key market segments.
* Provide application engineering support by reviewing customer specifications and technical documentation, collaborating with engineering teams, factories, and vendors to develop technically feasible and commercially sound proposals while ensuring compliance with applicable standards and regulations.
* Leverage ABB’s power protection and distribution portfolio to improve customer value and business opportunities, while continuously developing technical and commercial knowledge through professional training, including approximately two months of onboarding and technical training in Switzerland on ABB Critical Power products and global proposal management practices.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with a minimum of 8 years of experience in the electrical power, critical power, or energy infrastructure industry.
* Minimum 5 years of mandatory experience in UPS systems, including battery technologies, Battery Management Systems (BMS), power conversion equipment, and system integration.
* Solid technical knowledge of LV UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, electrical distribution systems, and power system studies and analysis.
* Experience in project engineering, proposal management, quotations, contract negotiations, technical sales, or solution engineering.
* Experience in data centers, semiconductor facilities, mission-critical infrastructure, or industrial power applications. Demonstrated experience managing projects for strategic global accounts.
* Clear communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global, cross-functional teams. Solid customer focus, commercial awareness, problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities are essential.
* Willingness and flexibility to travel domestically and internationally as required by business needs. Additional language proficiency.

**More about us:**
ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.
  
  
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.
  
  
View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life.
