Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Solution Engineer with deep expertise in F5 Inc. technologies and a forward-thinking understanding of emerging technologies like AI and containerization to join our dynamic team. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing robust, scalable, and secure application delivery and security solutions, leveraging the full capabilities of the F5 product suite, including F5 Distributed Cloud, while also considering the architectural implications of modern AI and cloud-native deployments.
  
  
You will act as a trusted advisor and contribute to thought leadership, collaborating with sales, engineering, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical architecture and drive successful project outcomes. You will also play a key role in supporting the Product and Engineering teams with the adoption and go-to-market strategy of new F5 products and features and potentially presenting at significant industry events.
  
  
Sounds interesting? Read on!
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Serve as the subject matter expert for F5 Inc. solutions, including BIG-IP (LTM, GTM, APM, AWAF), NGINX, and F5 Distributed Cloud Services.
* Design and architect comprehensive application delivery and security solutions that meet client requirements for performance, scalability, security, and high availability, with consideration for AI workloads and containerized environments, potentially leveraging F5 Distributed Cloud.
* Lead technical discussions with clients to understand their business needs, technical constraints, and articulate the value proposition of F5 Inc. solutions, including F5 Distributed Cloud, in the context of their overall IT landscape, including AI initiatives.
* Develop detailed solution designs, including diagrams, specifications, and implementation plans, potentially incorporating F5 (including Distributed Cloud) in support of AI Factories, RAG implementations, and AI Gateways.
* Provide technical guidance and support to sales teams during the pre-sales process, including presentations, demonstrations, and proposal development, highlighting how F5 Inc. solutions, including F5 Distributed Cloud, can enhance the delivery and security of AI-powered applications.
* Collaborate with engineering teams during the implementation and deployment phases, ensuring adherence to the defined architecture.
* Stay up to date with the latest F5 Inc. product updates, industry trends, and best practices, including developments in AI infrastructure, cloud-native technologies, and F5 Distributed Cloud.
* Contribute to the development of internal knowledge base, methodologies, and best practices related to F5 Inc. solutions (including Distributed Cloud) in modern application architectures.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues related to F5 deployments, potentially within Kubernetes environments, those supporting AI workloads, or utilizing F5 Distributed Cloud.
* Potentially mentor and guide junior team members.
* Contribute to thought leadership activities such as white papers, blog posts, presentations, and participation in industry forums, potentially including Mainstage Keynotes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to provide field feedback and support the introduction of new F5 products and features to the market.
* Lead and track Proof of Concepts (PoCs) with customers, ensuring successful technical validation and alignment with business requirements.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent level of experience
* Minimum of 15+ years of experience in designing and implementing network or application delivery solutions, with a strong focus on F5 Inc. is preferred.
* Deep technical expertise in F5 BIG-IP platform (LTM, GTM, APM, AWAF), ideally NGINX, and familiarity with F5 Distributed Cloud Services is a plus.
* Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, etc.) and security principles.
* Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Kubernetes is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with concepts related to AI, including AI Factories, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI Gateways.
* Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Ansible) for automation.
* Experience with Application-to-Application (A2A) concepts and familiarity with Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including experience with Mainstage Keynotes.
* Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Relevant F5 certifications (e.g., F5 Certified! Technology Specialist) are highly advantageous.
* Direct experience deploying or securing AI/ML applications is a bonus.
* Experience with F5 Distributed Cloud in customer deployments is a plus.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools like Terraform is preferred.
* Knowledge of other applications, delivery and security technologies.
* Experience in a consulting or professional services environment.
* Demonstrated contributions to thought leadership in the application delivery or security space, including Mainstage Keynotes.
* Experience providing feedback to Product and Engineering teams on product direction.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
  
  
Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
  
  
Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
  
  
Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
  
  
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
  
  
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
  
  
**About The Role**
Solutions Consultants at Razorpay are the linchpin of our enterprise sales team. You will be the technical and strategic partner to our sales team, bridging the gap between customer challenges and Razorpay's innovative payment solutions. This is not a traditional pre-sales role; it's a chance to be a change leader and a revenue catalyst. You'll be the voice of the customer to our product team, the expert in the room with our sales team, and the trusted advisor to some of the largest enterprises.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Solve Big Problems: Work closely with our enterprise sales team to understand customer business goals, challenges, and technical pain points. You'll architect solutions that solve their most complex payment problems, leveraging our core products and custom capabilities. Hence in-depth understanding of all our products is required.
* Craft Strategic Narratives: Create and deliver compelling presentations, detailed solution documents, and business proposals. You'll translate complex technical concepts into clear, executive-level narratives that demonstrate Razorpay's unique value proposition and quantify our business value.
* Drive Revenue: Act as a critical enabler for our enterprise sales pipeline. You'll lead technical discussions, build compelling solution demonstrations, and author detailed RFP responses for major deals. Your expertise and communication will directly influence our revenue attainment goals.
* Be an Industry Expert: Drive the strategic viewpoint of the organization towards specific vertical solutions. You'll use your deep industry knowledge to be a change leader for innovative solutions that solve larger, systemic problems within a particular vertical.
* Connect the Dots: Collaborate with sales, product, and engineering teams to ensure a seamless end-to-end process—from solution design to successful deployment for key deals. You'll be the go-to resource for connecting our technology to real-world business value.
* Champion Knowledge: Contribute to our internal knowledge base and foster a culture of expertise. You'll serve as a subject matter expert, mentoring peers and authoring documentation to elevate the entire team.

**What We're Looking For**

* Problem Solver: Proven creative problem-solving ability with a track record of leading and delivering full-lifecycle projects. You can demonstrate how to turn complex challenges into clear, actionable solutions.
* Payments Expert: At least 3-4 years of experience in the payments or fintech space, with a background in a product, solutions, or sales-related role.
* Technical Practitioner: Hands-on experience with technology is a must. You should be comfortable with APIs, technical definitions, and stitching together solutions across different platforms and partner ecosystems.
* Enterprise Advisor: Demonstrated expertise in providing advisory and guidance on large enterprise deployments and complex applications, with a history of identifying additional business opportunities.
* Influential Communicator: Exceptional verbal, presentation, and written communication skills. You have a proven ability to create and deliver technical and business-focused presentations and documents that influence others and achieve results.
* Documentation Finesse: Established ability in crafting compelling presentations & solution documents
* Education: An engineering background with an MBA is preferred.

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
  
  
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

title: Field Application Lead Engineer
description:

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
**Together, we advance your career.**
The Field Application Engineer position will be the technical interface for AMD’s embedded products with embedded customers in the INDIA region. As an Engineer, the role will be responsible for technical support for AMD’s embedded products, particularly FPGA and embedded x86 products. In this position, the individual will help AMD drive a new era of embedded computing by engaging with large INDIA end customers to demonstrate how AMD technology can be used to address the needs of their business. The role will provide technical support for AMD’s embedded pipeline with a special focus on pre-sales and development support activity as opportunities transition from opportunity to deployment. Building confidence with key customer influencers and overcoming technical objections will be critical for success in the role. Post-sales technical support is also required as the account encounters technical issues. The role will be expected to handle technical escalations that may occur and accelerate resolutions. The Engineer must have a strong technical knowledge base and skill-set but be equally effective in communication with both customers and internal AMD stakeholders. Must be proficient in troubleshooting in embedded platform, system and module-level design evaluations & developing reference designs.
  
  
**The Primary Focus Of The FAE Will Be To**

* Develop technical relationships with target end customer accounts
* Win new embedded opportunities at end customers by establishing technical solutions based on AMD technology
* Work with AMD internal teams across AMD Business Units to build technical presentations and documentation to be delivered in the field
* Deliver technical presentations and sales pitches to influence new AMD sales with customers and partners.

This position will require a broad technical understanding of embedded applications, especially in the communications segment. The position may require specialized knowledge of microprocessor and FPGA architectures, embedded knowledge including operating systems, BIOS & firmware is a plus.
  
  
**JOB REQUIREMENTS & Desired Skills/Exeperience**

* The preferred candidate should have a combination of relevant academic and professional experience. The minimum qualifications associated with this position are Bachelor Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering with 10+ years of experience, or advanced degree with 8+ years of experience.
* Solid hands-on experience with Vivado Design Suite and/or ISE
* Deep level knowledge of FPGA architecture
* Familiarity with various protocols and interfaces like Ethernet, PCIe, DDR etc
* Must demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to manage complex problems involving multi-disciplined, cross-functional teams
* High energy, results driven mentality with strong people/leadership skills.
* This position requires an individual with excellent organizational and communication skills with a good balance of hardware, architecture and software expertise. Must be a team player with excellent collaborative skills and superior written and oral communication skills

title: EY - GDS Consulting -AI Strategy & Go-To-Market
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**JOB DESCRIPTION | AI & DATA TECH CONSULTING**
**AI Strategy & Go-To-Market**
Career Family: AIA – AI Strategy & GTM
  
  

* Pursuits, RFPs & Offering Development

**LEVEL**
**Senior/Manager**
**Experience**
**8–12 years**
**LOCATION**
EY GDS
  
  

* Hybrid

**ORIENTATION**
**Strategy-led**
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
We are seeking a strategic Manager to join our AI & Data Tech Consulting team, focused on shaping how clients adopt Agentic AI and GenAI — and how the firm takes its AI offerings to market. The ideal candidate brings a blend of AI product strategy, solution positioning, and pursuit leadership, with enough technical fluency to credibly translate AI capabilities into business value, without being a hands-on builder.
  
  
You will work closely with account leaders, solution architects, C-suite stakeholders, and alliance partners to win and shape AI programs — owning the narrative from opportunity qualification and RFP response through solution storyboarding, commercial framing, and client orals.
  
  
**WHERE YOUR TIME GOES**
**40%**
**RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits**
Win themes, solution storyline, client orals
  
  
**30%**
**Go-To-Market & Offerings**
Positioning, enablement collateral, alliances
  
  
**30%**
**AI Strategy & Advisory**
Roadmaps, business cases, operating models
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
AI Strategy & Value Advisory
  
  
■ Partner with client leadership and Operating Partners to define AI / Agentic AI vision, use-case portfolios, and adoption roadmaps.
  
  
■ Build use-case prioritization frameworks (value vs. feasibility vs. risk) and translate them into phased roadmaps (discovery → MVP → scale).
  
  
■ Develop business cases with ROI, cost-to-serve, and value-realization metrics that leadership can fund against.
  
  
■ Frame AI operating models — CoE design, governance, Responsible AI guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  
  
■ Knowledge of business process transformation and industry value chains (Health, FS, Consumer, Industrials) would be an added advantage.
  
  
Go-To-Market & Offering Development
  
  
■ Shape and package AI offerings, accelerators, and assets into market-ready propositions — positioning, messaging, pricing logic, and differentiation.
  
  
■ Build sales enablement collateral: pitch decks, solution one-pagers, executive pagers, demo storylines, case studies, and battle cards.
  
  
■ Conduct market, competitive, and analyst research (vendors, hyperscalers, AI-native startups) to inform build / buy / partner decisions and offering roadmaps.
  
  
■ Work with alliance partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, ServiceNow, Salesforce, etc.) on joint GTM motions, co-sell plays, and partner-funded programs.
  
  
■ Track adoption and pipeline KPIs for offerings and feed market signals back into the offering roadmap.
  
  
RFPs, Proposals & Pursuits
  
  
■ Lead end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ responses for AI and data programs — bid / no-bid qualification, win themes, solution storyline, and response orchestration.
  
  
■ Translate client requirements into a crisp solution narrative, scope, delivery approach, staffing model, and commercial construct, in collaboration with architects and delivery leads.
  
  
■ Own proposal quality — compliance matrices, executive summaries, value articulation, risk and assumption logs.
  
  
■ Prepare and lead client orals, executive workshops, and proof-of-value storyboards; coach pursuit teams on messaging.
  
  
■ Maintain a reusable pursuit library of proposal content, case studies, and credentials.
  
  
AI Fluency (Conversational, Not Hands-On)
  
  
■ Working understanding of LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI frameworks, AI evaluation & observability, and LLMOps — enough to engage architects and challenge solutions credibly.
  
  
■ Awareness of AI risk, regulation, and governance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001) and how they shape client buying decisions.
  
  
■ Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI) and enterprise data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) at a solution level.
  
  
■ Comfort with AI productivity tools to accelerate research, content, and proposal creation.
  
  
Business Development & Client Management
  
  
■ Work closely with account leaders to identify, qualify, and shape opportunities and build tailored value propositions for strategic accounts.
  
  
■ Build trusted relationships with client CXOs, product owners, and transformation leaders.
  
  
■ Represent the firm at analyst briefings, industry forums, webinars, and thought-leadership platforms; author POVs, whitepapers, and blogs.
  
  
Team Leadership & Collaboration
  
  
■ Lead and mentor a small team of strategy consultants and pursuit analysts.
  
  
■ Orchestrate collaboration across solution architects, delivery, sector specialists, alliances, legal, and pricing teams.
  
  
■ Drive knowledge sharing, offering playbooks, and capability-building across the practice.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes**
Educational Background
  
  
■ MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  
■ 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting, solution / pre-sales, or GTM roles.
  
  
■ Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.
  
  
■ Experience building offerings, roadmaps, business cases, and executive-facing collateral for enterprise clients.
  
  
■ Exposure to market research, competitive benchmarking, startup / vendor evaluation, or innovation programs is a strong plus.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
■ Exceptional storytelling and executive presence — able to turn complex AI concepts into a compelling, simple business narrative.
  
  
■ Strong structured thinking and problem-solving; comfortable working under pursuit deadlines.
  
  
■ Excellent written communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, especially with C-suite executives.
  
  
■ Influencing without authority across large, matrixed pursuit teams.
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
■ GenAI / AI strategy certifications (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Coursera, ISB / IIM executive programs, etc.)
  
  
■ Product management or agile certifications (SAFe POPM / PM, Pragmatic, CSPO), Design Thinking.
  
  
■ APMP (proposal management) certification is a plus.
  
  
IDEAL PROFILE
  
  
**You will thrive here if you…**
■ Have taken AI / data products from 0 → 1 and know what drives adoption
  
  
■ Love building the story, the business case, and the winning proposal
  
  
■ Can hold your own with architects — and simplify for the CXO
  
  
■ Have run market scans, vendor evaluations, or innovation programs
  
  
**This role is not…**
■ A hands-on engineering or model-building role
  
  
■ Writing production code, data pipelines, or agent frameworks
  
  
■ Pure delivery / project management
  
  
■ A back-office bid-desk formatting role
  
  
WHY JOIN US
  
  
■ Shape how leading global enterprises adopt AI — and how the firm wins in the AI market.
  
  
■ Work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and growth, with direct visibility to account and practice leadership.
  
  
■ Collaborate with a team of AI experts, solution architects, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
■
**Continuous learning**
— You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
  
  
■
**Success as defined by you**
— We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
  
  
■
**Transformative leadership**
— We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
  
  
■
**Diverse and inclusive culture**
— You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Specialist Solutions Architect serves as the bridge between Customers, Product Management, Engineering, and Executive Leadership. Your mission is to transform these insights into product strategy, platform capabilities, and roadmap investments that shape the future of OneTrust's AI Governance portfolio.

with executives, architects, engineers, product leaders, legal stakeholders, privacy teams, and governance leaders.

and able to balance immediate customer needs with broader platform strategy.

and motivated by turning enterprise AI governance challenges into practical, high-impact solutions.

about responsible AI, emerging AI regulations, and helping customers adopt AI with trust and control.

, collaborative, and accountable, with the ability to move from strategy to detailed solution design.

title: Associate Enterprise Architect
description:
**About WSO2:**

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open-source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit
https://wso2.com
to learn more.

**Job Summary:**

Enterprise Architects are highly visible, enterprise-grade technical consultants who engage directly with WSO2 prospects and customers. This role is fundamental to establishing definitive thought leadership by providing high-level consultation and strategic guidance on addressing complex enterprise application challenges using the WSO2 platform.

As an Enterprise Architect, you will be responsible for translating ambitious business goals into technically precise, implementable solutions, directly supporting high-stakes sales and customer success initiatives.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Design custom demos and proof of concepts (POCs) that align with customer business needs. Evaluate RFP technical feasibility. Contribute to RFP responses by outlining technical and business capabilities.
* Map potential technologies to customer business and integration requirements.
* Clearly communicate technical and business benefits in presentations.
* Create high-quality solution designs that meet customer expectations.
* Develop subject matter expertise in WSO2 products, architecture, industry verticals, and competitive offerings. Apply this knowledge to enhance your personal brand, advise customers, and share expertise with the team.
* Provide feedback to teams on customer feature usage and alignment with design, implementation, and integration. Share architect expectations based on industry standards and developer/DevOps best practices. Raise and follow up on critical product issues and features.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of technology usage, including but not limited to WSO2 products, evolution, and future predictions within relevant domains and areas of specialization. Actively participate in discussions regarding technology, product features, direction, company vision, and process improvements.
* Lead technical aspects of project deliveries, collaborating closely with the delivery manager/PM. Take technical ownership, manage expectations, and communicate effectively with customers, the product team, service delivery personnel, and the internal team.
* Develop estimates and detailed schedules for complex projects, collaborating with product specialists.
* Communicate schedules clearly to customers and stakeholders, addressing assumptions, dependencies, and responsibilities.
* Conduct paid deployment reviews for customers, reviewing the solution and deployment architecture. Recommend best practices for using WSO2 products, aligning with customer requirements and use cases. Produce architectural review (AR) documents. Follow up on pending/future items with the customer and account manager (AM).
* Conduct technical workshops for customers, partners, and public users. Design workshop content tailored to diverse audiences, including CXOs, architects, developers, and DevOps engineers. Align content (slides, demos) with customer business problems and use cases.
* Assume primary or secondary technical ownership. Lead post-sales expansions, architectural reviews, and customer engagements. Participate in account planning with AMs. Conduct workshops, webinars, and customer events. Follow up on all post-sales activities. Build strong customer relationships and become a trusted advisor. Manage multiple accounts and prospects of varying size and complexity.
* Drive business and technical discussions with strategic accounts.
* Lead customer escalations. Collaborate with the support team to resolve critical production issues and conduct root cause analysis. Ensure issue resolution and customer satisfaction. Identify and address underlying problems, developing and implementing solutions.
* Lead and manage team members. Mentor new team members, ensuring role clarity and supporting their professional development.
* Write high-quality articles, blogs, and content that position you as an expert and drive traffic to WSO2. Focus on enterprise and business architecture content for CXOs and enterprise architects. Propose innovative concepts and patterns.
* Collaborate with marketing to deliver webinars, events, and public workshops. Design and lead sessions, ensuring market relevance.
* Leverage past experience to enhance team processes, individual skills (through knowledge sharing), and company vision. Adapt and implement successful strategies from previous roles within the WSO2 culture.
* Become an SME in a specific area, leveraging past experiences to improve WSO2. If no prior experience, develop expertise in a domain, subject matter, or industry vertical.
* Lead technical discussions within the team, demonstrating strong WSO2 product knowledge and a broad understanding of related technologies. Continuously expand technical breadth and share knowledge with the team, WSO2, and the wider community through talks, blogs, and articles.
* Lead and implement practices to enhance team productivity and quality. Initiate, collaborate, and lead tasks to improve team functions across the team, WSO2, and your specific pod/region. Measure the impact of initiatives and ensure their adoption and implementation into business-as-usual (BAU) operations.
* Continuously learn and share new ideas, concepts, and technologies with WSO2 and the team. Expand learning beyond technology to encompass areas like architecture, leadership, and management.

**Requirements:**

* BSc in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent.
* At least 8 to 10 years of solid industry experience, with at least 3 years as a Solution Architect or a similar role in Sales Engineering.
* Experience in business, system architecture principles, architecture patterns, processes, and frameworks.
* Exceptional client management and communication skills, ability to mentor team members, and negotiate technical decisions.
* Ability to travel on short notice for short-term assignments.

**In addition, you should:**

* Be willing to learn MSA, SOA, EDA, enterprise middleware, and cloud computing, while actively participating in the entire process, from design to implementation.
* Exhibit natural curiosity, an analytical mind, and a willingness to explore the unknown.
* Have an affinity for new challenges, a self-starting attitude, and a willingness to work with a global team.
* Be able to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution individually as well as work effectively through escalations with the engineering team.
* Possess an amicable personality and excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including sensitivity to the local cultures of WSO2’s global customer and employee base.
* Have the ability (e.g., passport) to travel overseas.

**Benefits:**

We want every team member to feel happy, cared for, and energized at WSO2. That's why, in addition to our performance-driven commission structure, we offer benefits and facilities designed to support your life and work.

* Flexible Leave Policy: We trust you to manage your time and performance. Enjoy a flexible vacation policy as long as you continue to demonstrate your commitment to shared goals.
* Comprehensive Healthcare: Your health is a priority. You are entitled to Health Benefits as detailed in the Company Healthcare plan.
* Essential Equipment: Start strong with a laptop provided as per standard company specifications. You can also request additional equipment like a mouse, keyboard, or monitor to build your ideal workspace.

**Diversity Drives Innovation:**

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Leucine And Celestara**

**12 of the top 15 generic pharma companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.**

Leucine builds AI-powered software that helps pharmaceutical manufacturers stay compliant, audit-ready and productive, so medicines reach patients faster. Manufacturing, QA and QC teams use Leucine across thousands of regulated workflows, from material receipt to batch release, for small molecules, biologics, vaccines and more.

Celestara is our platform for building and running those solutions: data pipelines, agnotology that models the customer's operations, agentic workflows and applications on top.

**About The Role**

You will sit with our customers, understand how their work really gets done, and turn their highest-value problems into live solutions on Celestara. You own each use case end to end: from discovery and business case, through design and build, to UAT, go-live in production, and then its adoption, maintenance and ongoing iteration.

This is a hybrid role. Think product manager, solution architect and hands-on builder in one person, working inside the customer's four walls rather than from a distance. Most of our customers are in pharma, but you do not need prior pharma experience. We care far more about curiosity, empathy for users and the ability to learn a new domain fast.

**Location - India and United States, deployed on-site at customer locations**

**What You'll Do**

Understand the problem

* Embed with customer teams on the shop floor, in QA/QC labs and in offices; shadow users and learn how work actually happens
* Run discovery workshops and interviews; build empathy for users' pain points, constraints and incentives
* Produce clear as-is process maps: steps, roles, hand-offs, systems, data sources and where time, cost and errors pile up

Build the business case

* Run ROI assessments: baseline current effort, cycle time, error and rework rates, and quantify the value of the future state
* Prioritise use cases with the customer by value, feasibility and time to impact

Reimagine the solution on Celestara

* Design the to-be process and solution in the context of the platform, not as a one-off workaround
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data sources and transformation pipelines, ontology and data model, agentic workflows, application screens and user journeys, integrations and access controls
* Write crisp specs and user stories; make trade-offs and say no when scope does not serve the outcome

Deliver from UAT to production

* Configure and build on Celestara, hands-on, working with our product and engineering teams for anything new
* Plan and run UAT with customer users; triage feedback, fix issues and drive sign-off
* Lead go-live, hyper care and adoption; measure the outcomes against the ROI baseline
* Support validation and documentation needed in a regulated environment, with help from our domain experts

Own the use case after go-live

* Drive adoption: train users, track usage and close the gaps that stop people from relying on the solution
* Maintain the use case in production: monitor pipelines, workflows and agents, resolve issues and manage changes under the customer's change-control process
* Iterate continuously: gather feedback, measure impact against the ROI baseline and ship improvements release after release

Be the voice of the customer

* Feed field insights back to product: patterns across customers, gaps in the platform, ideas for reusable components and templates
* Build trusted relationships with users, process owners and senior stakeholders; identify the next use cases to expand into

**Requirements**

**What we're looking for**

**Customer and problem obsession**
. You listen first, ask sharp questions and can explain a user's problem better than they can.

**Product thinking.**
Experience as a product manager, solutions consultant, business analyst or similar; you can go from a messy problem to a prioritised, well-specified solution.

**Process and value analysis.**
You have done as-is/to-be process mapping and can build a credible ROI or business case with real numbers.

**Technical fluency.**
You already understand, or can quickly learn, how modern data and AI platforms fit together:

* data integration, transformation and pipelines (ETL/ELT)
* data modelling and ontologies (entities, relationships, semantics)
* agentic and LLM-powered workflows, automation and orchestration
* application design: user journeys, screens, roles and permissions
* APIs and enterprise system integration

**Hands-on builder.**
Comfortable configuring a platform, writing SQL, and scripting (e.g. Python) to get things working; you do not wait for someone else to build.

**Delivery ownership.**
You have taken work through UAT and into production and stayed accountable for adoption and outcomes.

**Communication.**
Clear written and verbal English; equally at ease with an operator on the floor and a VP in a steering committee.

**Ready to be on the ground.**
Willing to be deployed at customer sites in India or the US and travel as needed.

**Fast learner**
. Comfortable picking up a complex, regulated domain like pharma manufacturing and quality. No prior pharma knowledge required.

**Nice to have**

* Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or implementation lead at an enterprise SaaS, data or AI platform company
* Exposure to platforms built on ontologies or semantic layers, or to low-code/no-code application builders
* Hands-on work with LLMs, prompt design, RAG or agent frameworks
* Background in manufacturing, life sciences, quality or other regulated industries (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV/CSA)
* An engineering, computer science, data or operations degree, or equivalent experience
* 3-8 years experience (indicative; strong builders with less are welcome)

**Benefits**

**What success looks like**

* By 30 days - Learned Celestara hands-on, shadowed a live deployment and grasped the basics of pharma manufacturing and quality workflows
* By 90 days - Owned discovery for a customer use case: as-is map, ROI case and a Celestara solution design the customer has signed off
* By 180 - days Taken at least one use case through UAT into production, with measurable adoption and impact, and identified the next use cases with that customer

**Why join us**

* Real impact. Your work helps medicines get made right and reach patients faster. Ownership. You own outcomes, not tickets, with direct access to customers, product and leadership
* Breadth. Product, data, AI and operations in one role; a fast track into product leadership, solution architecture or customer leadership
* Frontier tech in the real world. Put agentic AI and ontology-driven applications into production in one of the most demanding industries

**Other Benefits**

* Market leading compensation + uncapped variable
* Opportunity for fast-track growth & leadership
* Work with a purpose-driven, global team transforming an essential industry
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Strategic Builder
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.
  
  
Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value.
  
  
Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
* AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
* Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
* Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
* Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
* AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
* Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
* Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
* AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
* Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 4+ years experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
* Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
* Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
* Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
* Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
* Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

**Even Better If...**

* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
* Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
* Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
* Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
* A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

title: Principal Field Applications Engineer – Memory Characterization
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated
**Principal Applications Engineer**
to support deployment and adoption of advanced memory characterization solutions at leading semiconductor companies worldwide.
  
  
This role combines deep technical expertise in
**memory design, characterization, circuit simulation, and library generation**
with strong customer engagement and technical leadership skills. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them develop, validate, and optimize memory characterization methodologies while working closely with R&D, Product Management, and worldwide field teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with memory design and characterization flows and hands-on knowledge of industry-standard characterization tools such as
**LiberateMX**
,
**PrimeLib**
,
**SiliconSmart**
, or similar solutions. Experience with memory circuit simulation and signoff technologies including
**HSPICE**
,
**PrimeSim XA**
,
**CustomSim**
,
**Spectre**
,
**NanoTime**
, and
**PrimeTime**
is highly desirable.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  
**Customer Engagement & Technical Leadership**

* Serve as the primary technical interface for strategic semiconductor customers deploying memory characterization solutions.
* Lead customer evaluations, proof-of-concepts, benchmarks, and production deployments.
* Work directly with customer memory design, characterization, CAD, methodology, and library teams to understand requirements and drive successful adoption.
* Provide technical leadership during customer escalations and resolve complex issues involving memory design, SPICE simulation, characterization, library generation, and signoff validation.
* Deliver technical presentations, methodology reviews, workshops, and training sessions.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor helping customers improve characterization quality, runtime, scalability, and deployment readiness.
* Drive competitive displacement opportunities involving migration from alternative solutions such as LiberateMX and other characterization environments.
* Coordinate cross-functional efforts involving Applications Engineering, Product Management, R&D, and customer engineering teams.
* Travel as needed to support key customer engagements, deployments, and strategic initiatives.

**Technical Responsibilities**

* Support characterization of SRAMs, register files, ROMs, embedded memories, custom memory macros, and memory compilers.
* Develop and optimize memory characterization methodologies across advanced process technologies.
* Debug and resolve characterization, modeling, simulation, convergence, and library quality issues.
* Drive validation and correlation activities for timing, power, leakage, and variation-aware models.
* Assist customers in deploying scalable production characterization flows.
* Collaborate with R&D to reproduce customer issues and influence future product enhancements.

title: Team Lead: 910
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a dedicated and innovative RGM Lead Consultant with 5 to 7 years of experience to join our dynamic team in Bengaluru. This role leads the design and delivery of an integrated Revenue Growth Management (RGM) decision engine that operates at the PPG/retailer level and connects insights to actions across the entire value chain. You will help our CPG and retail clients turn data into decisions across business diagnosis, shopper understanding, availability, assortment, price-pack architecture, pricing and promotions, retail execution, and value realization — powering their Annual Business Planning (ABP) and Joint Business Planning (JBP) cycles.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts and consultants to develop and deploy advanced analytics that power an end-to-end RGM solution while fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
* Drive business diagnosis by building category health, competitor, promotion / flyer-feature, rolling retailer-profit, and innovation-performance analyses that identify winners and drainers and answer "how is the business doing?"
* Translate shopper understanding into commercial action through occasion analysis and pack-switching studies that reveal who is buying, why, and what they need.
* Strengthen availability and replenishment with demand forecasting that improves fill rate and reduces out-of-stocks, ensuring the plan can satisfy demand.
* Optimize shelf and assortment through SKU prioritization and white-space detection to define what should be on the shelf and where unaddressed growth exists.
* Design price-pack architecture using PPA and pack analytics, pack-and-mix optimization, trade-up and cannibalization analysis, and mix-and-margin simulation to determine which packs should win were.
* Develop pricing and promotion recommendations — price-gap and price-recommendation engines, trade promotion and spend optimization (TPO / TSO), promo calendar and scenario planning, and offer / tactic optimization — that rank the best net-P&L levers while respecting that the retailer decides.
* Enable retail execution with execution trackers and feedback loops, pre / post-event tracking, and retailer scorecards and compliance to confirm plans are executed correctly.
* Measure value realization through attribution and impact measurement, KPI dashboards, test-and-learn frameworks, and continuous optimization — closing the loop so performance feeds back and insight feeds forward via model refreshes and elasticity updates.
* Utilize MySQL and Python to extract, engineer, and analyze large, multi-source datasets (sales, volume, share, OOS, fill rate, promo ROI, margin), ensuring accuracy and relevance in reporting for strategic decision-making.
* Partner cross-functionally with client sales, category, finance, and supply teams to embed analytics into ABP and JBP and to influence stakeholders at all levels.

**Expected Outcomes :**

* Deliver a ranked view of the best net-P&L levers, along with a clean price ladder and well-defined SKU roles, that measurably increases revenue, volume, and market share within the first year.
* Improve margin, profitability, and trade-spend ROI across own-brand, private-label, and co-manufacturer portfolios through optimized price-pack and promotion decisions.
* Raise availability and fill rate and strengthen retailer partnerships by aligning demand, assortment, and execution plans within the ABP and JBP process.
* Achieve a minimum of 20% improvement in forecasting and elasticity-model accuracy through advanced analytics, disciplined test-and-learn, and continuous optimization.
* Establish best practices in data engineering, modeling, and value tracking that enhance team productivity and make value realization visible and repeatable.

**Qualifications (Skills/Competencies) :**

* 5 to 7 years in analytics or consulting with a strong foundation in Revenue Growth Management, pricing and promotion, and market-mix / elasticity modeling.
* Proficiency in MySQL for large-scale data extraction and manipulation, with Python for data analysis and model development highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience across the RGM toolkit: price-pack architecture, trade promotion and spend optimization (TPO / TSO), demand forecasting, assortment and white-space analysis, and promo scenario planning.
* Solid understanding of statistics and a proven ability to apply statistical methods to real-world commercial challenges
* CPG / retail domain knowledge, including familiarity with syndicated and point-of-sale data (e.g., Nielsen, Circana / IRI) and ABP / JBP planning cycles (preferred).
* Ability to build KPI dashboards and clearly communicate insights, with excellent leadership skills and a proven ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for data analytics and a proven track record of leading teams to success, we encourage you to apply. Join us in shaping the future of revenue growth management and making a significant impact in a collaborative and inclusive environment. Your insights could be the key to our clients' next big breakthrough!

**Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Presales Consultant to act as the techno-commercial bridge between Ecolibrium's business development team and enterprise customers across commercial real estate (CRE), connected factories and data centres. Reporting to the Senior Manager – Technical Sales, you will drive discovery, design solution architectures and run proof-of-concepts and pilots that demonstrate quantifiable value, including energy savings, uptime improvement and maintenance cost reduction, across discrete and process industries.

You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery and Procurement to translate customer requirements into robust technical solutions, proposals and implementation plans, and support technical selling through to deal close. This is a hands-on presales role requiring strong technical solutioning, stakeholder management, commercial acumen and the ability to simplify Industry 4.0 concepts for business audiences. It requires 5–7 years of relevant experience.

**THE WORK**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct site walkthroughs, stakeholder workshops and requirement deep-dives across production, maintenance, energy and IT/OT teams in CRE, connected factory and data centre environments.
* Build ROI/TCO models with clear KPIs, including power reduction, demand optimisation, asset uptime and MTBF/MTTR improvement across electrical, mechanical and workplace solutions, with review from the Senior Manager – Technical Sales on large or complex deals.
* Apply working knowledge of HVAC and mechanical controls concepts across CRE, manufacturing and retail environments.
* Design end-to-end solutions spanning sensors/gateways, connectivity, AI/ML analytics and dashboards.
* Configure and deliver tailored demos, and plan and run PoCs/pilots with defined success criteria, test plans and acceptance gates.
* Produce SoWs, solution architecture documents, BoMs/sizing, integration architecture diagrams and pricing inputs to support the sales team.
* Own technical selling and solution walkthroughs with the client from the second round of discussion through to deal close, alongside the sales team.
* Prepare RFI/RFP responses, compliance matrices and technical due diligence, with final sign-off from the Senior Manager – Technical Sales.
* Assess existing monitoring tools and define integrations with EMS/BMS/SCADA/MES/ERP/CMMS and historians (e.g. PI, Ignition), using protocols including OPC UA, Modbus/TCP, BACnet, MQTT and API integration.

About WeiTA

WeiTA (We are Human in TA) is a
**strategic talent partner**
to enterprises, global capability centres and startups across India. Our purpose is to bring the human back into human resources, so talent and business always stay together.

We work by one belief:
**Talent Decisions Driven By Conversation.**

Why WeiTA started

Businesses are growing fast, and the skills they need are becoming more specialised. Yet most companies still find people the old way. They wait until a job opens, post it, sort through CVs, and hope the right person shows up. This is called requisition-based or transactional hiring, where every job is a one-time deal that starts from zero.

Over time, this
**process became a cost, and it created a distance between companies and the people they need.**
By the time a role opens, the best people are already busy elsewhere, and the role sits empty for months.

What is new

WeiTA brings a
**new operating model for talent acquisition.**
We start
**before the job opens.**
Companies move from transactional hiring to a standing talent ecosystem, a circle of the right people who already know the company and its leaders and are ready when a need comes up.

The heart of this is the
**Talent Connect room.**
In a single day, it brings
**potential talent and the company’s leaders together in one room.**
They talk, work on real problems together, and get to know each other. Beyond the room, WeiTA keeps attracting and engaging potential talent regularly.

**What it offers clients**

WeiTA gives its partners five things in one package: critical and niche hiring, employer branding, a stronger employee value proposition, market intelligence, and campus and early-career talent.

**How we work**

Attract. Understand the capability the business needs next, map where it sits, and bring the right professionals in.

Engage. Keep those professionals close to the company’s leaders through year-round conversations, content and working sessions.

Convert. Turn relationships into decisions, most visibly in the Talent Connect room.

**The role**

You will take WeiTA to the market as part of a small, early team, working directly with the founding team. Pre-sales is the main focus. You will help drive the organisation’s growth and revenue, set up the structure the business runs on, and help WeiTA bring every organisation into direct, human engagement with the people who could change it.

**What you will do**

* Research target companies before each client conversation
* Build proposals, pitch decks and case studies
* Present decks to clients, alongside the founding team at first and then on your own
* Connect with C-suite executives and senior leaders through cold calls, emails, LinkedIn and in-office discussions
* Manage stakeholders, build relationships and handle client accounts
* Run weekly and monthly client meetings and follow-ups
* Track industries, companies and talent trends in India, and bring those insights to clients to open service engagements and consulting conversations
* Run email and LinkedIn campaigns using the right tools, such as HubSpot and Zoho
* Plan and publish posts that grow WeiTA’s visibility
* Create assets such as process documents, market research reports and marketing campaigns, and act as a consultant on client challenges.

**What we look for**

* MBA (2025 or 2026 graduate) or B.Tech (2025 or 2026 batch)
* 0 to 1 year of experience, with at least one piece of real work behind you, such as an internship, a college project with real users or outcomes, or a venture you started or co-founded
* You think strategically and are curious about how businesses grow
* You enjoy variety and pick up new things quickly

**Good to have (or willing to learn)**

* Basics of email or LinkedIn campaigns (theory is fine)
* Basic HTML, CSS, JavaScript or Python, or building with AI coding tools

**What you get**

* Competitive, in line with market standards, plus uncapped incentives
* Early exposure to the leadership team and how the business is run
* Early exposure to clients, learning how to pitch, sell and own an account
* Uncapped incentives
* Flexible login and logout times
* A quarterly team lunch

**Who will enjoy this role**

Someone who has started or co-founded a venture, worked in a stealth startup, or recently graduated with a curious mind and wants to see how a business is built and sold.

**How to apply**

Apply at weita.in/careers or email your CV to career@weita.in with a short note on a project you have led or worked on.

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
AI Architect Senior Advisor
  
  
The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is a senior, customer-facing practitioner who connects customer needs, measurable business outcomes, and technology solutions. Working directly within customer environments, the FDE partners with business and technical stakeholders to understand complex challenges, reduce ambiguity, make opportunities tangible, and establish a credible path from idea to production value.
  
  
The FDE combines depth in a relevant specialist discipline with broad knowledge of company and partner platforms, products, accelerators, and reusable assets. They apply domain context, technical judgement, and commercial awareness to identify high-impact opportunities and determine the most appropriate route to the customer outcome, including bespoke AI delivery, product capabilities, platform or infrastructure services, and reuse of existing assets.
  
  
The FDE acts as the persistent outcome thread between customer stakeholders and internal engineering, product, architecture, delivery, and operations teams. They shape validated opportunities into delivery-ready work, remain connected through implementation and adoption, and use customer feedback and production evidence to guide improvement without replacing the accountable production delivery or managed service teams.
  
  
Combining domain understanding, technical credibility, strong client emotional intelligence, and outcome leadership, the FDE operates independently in ambiguous enterprise environments and is trusted to lead complex customer engagements. The role requires hands-on problem solving, sound judgement, effective stakeholder influence, and the ability to orchestrate the right capabilities while maintaining focus on measurable customer value and scalable delivery.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers and stakeholders to understand business objectives, workflow challenges, desired outcomes, and the measures that will demonstrate success.
* Lead discovery, assessment, and solution-shaping activities that translate ambiguous business needs into clear, prioritised opportunities.
* Establish outcome hypotheses, success measures, key assumptions, and customer ownership before recommending material investment or progression.
* Create or direct rapid prototypes, proof points, experiments, and demonstrations that test the assumptions most critical to value and feasibility.
* Assess solution feasibility across AI, data, integration, architecture, security, privacy, Responsible AI, operational readiness, and cost considerations.
* Shape validated opportunities into production-ready work, including target workflow, architecture direction, prioritised backlog, dependencies, acceptance direction, estimates, and mobilisation requirements.
* Build trusted relationships with technical, business, and senior stakeholders, providing clear guidance and constructive challenge throughout customer engagements.
* Collaborate across engineering, architecture, product, delivery, operations, industry, transformation, and account teams to orchestrate the capabilities required for successful outcomes.
* Analyze and resolve complex business, technical, and operational challenges using sound judgement, evidence, and structured problem-solving.
* Identify high-value use cases by combining domain context, stakeholder insight, technology capability, feasibility, and measurable business impact.
* Determine the most appropriate delivery route, including AI Studio, company products, AI Factory, transformation services, partner capabilities, reuse, further validation, or stop.
* Maintain the outcome thread as work moves into delivery by validating major decisions, assumptions, user feedback, adoption needs, and continued alignment to the intended value.
* Capture field feedback, implementation learning, defects, feature requests, customer signals, and reusable patterns from customer engagements.
* Contribute to internal IP, accelerators, reference architectures, implementation playbooks, reusable assets, and continuous improvement of the Forward Deployed and AI Studio methods.
* Provide guidance, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to FDE Candidates and delivery practitioners to strengthen capability and successful outcomes.
* Role may require working at customer sites, company offices, or hybrid delivery locations depending on engagement needs.

**Knowledge and Attributes**

* Strong domain awareness with the ability to understand customer workflows, value drivers, operating constraints, industry context, and relevant success measures.
* Strong technical credibility across enterprise solution architecture, engineering practices, data, integration, cloud platforms, and production technology delivery.
* Applied understanding of artificial intelligence, generative AI, agentic systems, RAG, automation, model and tool integration, and emerging AI technologies.
* Understanding of production AI considerations including evaluation, security, privacy, Responsible AI, observability, AgentOps, FinOps, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Strong client emotional intelligence, consulting, stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly in senior customer environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, critical-thinking, experimentation, and evidence-based decision-making capabilities.
* Deep working expertise in at least one relevant specialist area such as AI engineering, architecture, industry, transformation, product, data, or AI infrastructure.
* Broad knowledge of relevant company and partner platforms, products, accelerators, implementation methods, and reusable assets, and when to apply them.
* Ability to learn and apply domain context quickly, including processes, terminology, regulations, data flows, user roles, constraints, and business metrics.
* Commercial awareness to connect technical choices with business value, risk, cost, time to value, adoption, and the appropriate delivery model.
* Strong outcome leadership, including the ability to define measurable outcomes, surface assumptions, prioritise evidence, and drive Build, Iterate, Route, or Stop decisions.
* Strong reuse and product-feedback mindset, including the ability to distinguish customer-specific needs from patterns and improvements that should be scaled.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly with domain, business, executive, engineering, architecture, and operational stakeholders using the appropriate level of detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, challenge constructively, and balance business, technical, commercial, and operational priorities.
* Ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple organizational levels without relying on formal authority.
* Strong collaboration, relationship-building, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing skills, with a bias toward creating customer and practice capability rather than individual dependency.

**Required Qualifications And Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Relevant industry certifications in cloud technologies, solution architecture, data, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, agile delivery, industry domains, or related disciplines are beneficial. Certifications support but do not replace demonstrated FDE capability and accreditation.

**Required Experience**

* Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in software or AI engineering, solution architecture, consulting, customer engineering, product engineering, industry transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines, with equivalent demonstrated depth considered.
* Significant experience working directly with enterprise customers and building credibility with business, technical, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience independently leading discovery, problem framing, solution shaping, or complex customer workstreams in ambiguous environments.
* Experience creating or directing prototypes, proof points, technical experiments, or working solutions to validate customer and technology assumptions.
* Experience shaping and delivering enterprise technology solutions involving architecture, data, integration, security, deployment, and production constraints.
* Experience applying domain or functional context to customer workflows, constraints, KPIs, value drivers, and solution decisions.
* Experience connecting technology decisions to measurable customer outcomes, adoption, business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, or customer experience.
* Experience collaborating with product, engineering, platform, industry, transformation, delivery, and business teams to determine the right solution and delivery route.
* Experience evaluating build, buy, reuse, product, partner, and platform options pragmatically rather than defaulting to bespoke implementation.
* Experience operating within complex enterprise environments and navigating dependencies across technology, data, governance, operations, and customer organizations.
* Experience operating independently, exercising sound judgement, influencing decisions, and maintaining momentum through uncertainty and changing priorities.
* Experience capturing reusable patterns, field feedback, lessons learned, methodologies, accelerators, or other assets that improve future delivery.
* Experience providing guidance, mentoring, peer review, or knowledge sharing to colleagues and developing practitioners.

**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: Principal Partner Solutions Architect
description:
**What makes us Qlik?**
A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly.
  
  
Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in.
  
  
**The Principal Partner Solutions Architect Role**
Principal Partner Solutions Architect will be primarily responsible for establishing mutual solution vision and technical integration across product offerings with both new and future strategic partners. By fostering deeper integration with our technology partners, we will be able to expand our reach into key enterprise level opportunities and, more importantly, create more effective solutions to help address the customer's requirements.
  
  
Qlik is rapidly growing our system Integrators Go to Market Initiatives. GSI’s are a integral part of our business to help customers unlock the Power of Data. We are looking for a self-driven go-getter to help grow these GSI’s into profitable revenue streams and accelerate the growth of the business.
  
  
Success in this position requires the candidate to be a ninja at managing relationships, execute programs, set goals and metrics, track and ensure progress. The candidate will also need help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share among Qlik’s SI Partners.
  
  
**What makes this role interesting?**

* Engage with high-profile customers and partners: Lead technical discussions and showcase innovative solutions to help organizations unlock the true power of their data.
* Drive business success with cutting-edge technology: Leverage Qlik’s next-generation data analytics and data integration platform to solve complex business challenges.
* Be at the forefront of industry trends: Stay ahead of the game by keeping up with the latest advancements in data analytics, as well as the competitive landscape.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work closely with internal teams and experts across Sales, Marketing, R&D, and Customer Success to build compelling solutions that resonate with customers.
* Flexibility and agility: Thrive in an environment that values adaptability, innovation, and dynamic thinking.

* Excellent written communication skills, analytical skills and reporting to internal & external stakeholders
* Proven experience of delivering technical solutioning and successful implementations leading to customer success
* Excellent presentation abilities and composure in front of all levels of technical and business customers or prospects.
* Ability to work as part of a virtual team in delivering enablement, workshops and presales support
