title: Solar Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
SolarSquare is India’s fastest-growing residential solar company, ranked No.1 home solar provider on the National Solar Portal. The company specializes in end-to-end rooftop solar solutions, handling design, installation, and ongoing management through a team of solar experts. SolarSquare’s mission is to make going solar simple, reliable, and worry-free, enabling homeowners to switch to clean energy with confidence. The organization focuses on quality, customer trust, and long-term performance of solar systems to deliver strong value and savings for its customers.

**Role Description**
The Solar Consultant role is a full-time hybrid position based in Bengaluru, with some flexibility for work from home. In this role, the consultant will engage with prospective customers, explain rooftop solar solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and purchase process. Day-to-day tasks include generating and qualifying leads, conducting consultations (in-person and virtual), assessing customer needs and property conditions, and preparing basic proposals in line with SolarSquare’s offerings. The Solar Consultant will coordinate with internal technical and installation teams, maintain accurate records in CRM tools, and provide ongoing support to customers to ensure a smooth transition to solar. The role also involves educating customers on solar benefits, financing options, and system performance to build trust and drive conversions.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess knowledge of the Solar Industry and Solar Power fundamentals, including basic understanding of rooftop systems and residential energy needs.
* Candidates should possess Lead Generation skills, with the ability to identify, qualify, and nurture prospective customers through multiple channels.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to explain technical concepts clearly and build confidence with diverse customers.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills, with a focus on responsiveness, empathy, and maintaining long-term relationships.
* Relevant experience in sales or consulting, ideally in renewable energy, home solutions, or related industries.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment, manage time independently, and travel locally within Bengaluru as required.
* Comfort using CRM software and basic office productivity tools to document interactions and track opportunities.
* Undergraduate degree in business, engineering, environmental sciences, or a related field is preferred, though equivalent experience is also valued.

title: Principal Application Engineer, VC Formal
description:
**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
You have spent a decade or more in verification and you know that formal is not a checkbox, it is the difference between finding a corner case bug in week two or in production six months later. You walk into a customer site, look at their design blocks and test benches, and see the problem underneath the symptoms. You ask questions that get to root cause, not surface noise.
  
  
You have debugged enough performance bottlenecks to know when the issue is the tool, the model, or the design itself, and you can explain the tradeoff in terms the design team will understand. You are comfortable presenting to senior engineers and equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves to optimize a formal test bench that is choking on state space explosion.
  
  
At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers building the most complex chips in the industry, and what you recommend will shape how they verify their designs.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead technical deployment of VC Formal solutions at customer sites, assessing verification environments and recommending formal methodologies tailored to their design challenges
* Analyze customer design blocks to identify the right targets for formal property checking, sequential equivalence checking, formal coverage analysis, and connectivity checking
* Diagnose root causes of tool performance issues, including state space explosion and convergence problems, then optimize formal test benches to achieve proof closure
* Develop and deliver technical training to customer teams on new VC Formal features, product updates, and formal verification best practices
* Work directly with Synopsys R&D and product engineering teams to communicate customer priorities and technical requirements that influence product roadmap
* Support customers in applying formal verification to complex logic including data path verification, math functions, and sequential equivalence across design revisions

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to find critical bugs earlier in the design cycle, reducing costly respins and time-to-market delays
* Drive adoption of formal verification methodologies that improve verification coverage and confidence across complex SoC and IP designs
* Shape the VC Formal product roadmap by translating real-world customer challenges into actionable engineering requirements
* Accelerate customer productivity by delivering training and methodologies that make formal verification accessible to teams with varying levels of expertise
* Build long-term technical relationships with leading semiconductor companies, becoming a trusted advisor on verification strategy
* Reduce tool performance bottlenecks and proof times through expert modeling and optimization, directly improving customer ROI

**What You'll Need**

* 10 to 15 years of hands-on experience in digital design verification, with deep expertise in formal verification methodologies
* Strong application knowledge of formal property checking, sequential equivalence checking, formal coverage analysis, and connectivity checking
* Proven experience diagnosing and resolving formal tool performance issues, including convergence problems and proof optimization
* Solid understanding of RTL design, SystemVerilog, and verification test bench development
* Experience working directly with customers in a technical consulting, application engineering, or field engineering role
* Experience with VC Formal or equivalent formal verification tools is a strong plus

**Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a verification challenge, and sketch out a formal methodology that makes immediate sense to the team
* You know when to push back on a customer request that will not solve the real problem, and you can explain why in terms they respect
* You are comfortable moving between deep technical debugging, writing formal properties, and presenting results to engineering leadership
* You treat every customer deployment like a learning opportunity, not just for them but for the product team back at Synopsys
* You are organized enough to manage multiple customer engagements at once and technical enough to go deep when a proof is failing

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
Application engineers (AEs)
**drive and deploy**
SNPS technologies at the customers and
**support**
successful usage of the products at the customers that leads to renewals and new business.
  
  
**Rewards And Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: VC Formal Staff Application Engineer
description:
**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
**You Are**
You have spent years in the trenches of formal verification, and you know the difference between a proof that closes and one that explodes the state space at 2am. You understand that formal is not magic, it is a precise tool that works brilliantly when applied to the right problem with the right setup, and you have developed the instinct to know which is which.
  
  
You are comfortable walking into a customer's verification environment, looking at their design blocks and assertion strategy, and quickly seeing where formal will shine and where it will struggle. Diagnosing why a formal run is slow or why convergence stalled does not frustrate you, it engages you. You think in terms of abstraction, state space, and proof complexity, and you can refactor a formal testbench so the tool can actually finish.
  
  
At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers deploying VC Formal across complex SoC and IP designs, and what you recommend will directly shape how they verify their next chip.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead technical deployment of VC Formal at customer sites, assessing their verification environments and recommending formal methodologies that fit their design challenges
* Analyze customer design blocks to identify the right candidates for formal property checking, sequential equivalence, connectivity checking, and formal coverage analysis
* Diagnose root causes of tool performance issues and design complexity bottlenecks, then optimize formal testbench modeling to achieve proof closure
* Develop and deliver technical training on VC Formal features, product updates, and formal verification best practices
* Work with Synopsys R&D teams to communicate customer priorities and technical requirements that influence product roadmap

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable customers to catch critical design bugs earlier, reducing costly respins and time to tapeout
* Drive measurable improvements in formal tool performance and proof convergence through optimized modeling
* Influence the VC Formal product roadmap by translating customer pain points into actionable R&D priorities
* Expand formal verification adoption by demonstrating clear ROI and building internal customer champions
* Build reusable formal methodologies that scale across multiple customer engagements and design domains

**What You'll Need**

* 4 to 8 years of hands-on experience applying formal verification in semiconductor design or verification roles
* Deep expertise in formal property checking, including writing assertions, constraints, and assumptions for complex digital designs
* Proven experience with sequential equivalence checking, formal coverage analysis, and connectivity checking methodologies
* Strong understanding of formal verification theory, including state space exploration, abstraction techniques, and proof convergence strategies
* Experience diagnosing and resolving formal tool performance issues and testbench modeling optimization
* Ability to assess customer verification environments and recommend tailored formal solutions

* You can explain why an assertion is vacuous or a constraint is overconstrained without making someone feel like they did it wrong
* You are comfortable saying "formal is not the right fit here" when simulation would be faster, because credibility matters more than a tool sale
* You can manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously without dropping threads or missing commitments

title: Technical Account Manager
description:

As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team**
The Splunk Agent Resilience team is defining the future of AI resilience. Together our team provides scalable, cost-effective evaluation and guardrails that ensure AI agents behave as intended, improving reliability and reducing risks. This unified approach empowers our customers to expertly deploy and manage AI-powered applications with enhanced observability and control.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation to help some of the world's largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. You'll partner closely with external customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with internal Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, You Will**

Customer and partner success

Consumption and business growth

Continuous learning and innovation

description:
****Who we are:****
80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity.Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers — and the people supporting them — to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.We are a remote-first, global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India. We are backed by leading investors including Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
  
  
**About The Role**
Zinier is looking for a sharp, analytical generalist to work closely with senior leadership on business development, partnerships, strategy, and company building. Think of it as the work of a strong consulting Associate, but from inside a growth-stage B2B SaaS company.
  
  
You will not need prior expertise in every area. What matters is your ability to
**learn quickly, think clearly, communicate simply, and execute with high quality.**
**What You Will Work On**

* Business development: Understand client and partner problems, shape solutions, and build the pitch decks and proposals that go into those conversations.
* Partnerships: Research potential partners, build partnership theses, and support leadership in partner discussions.
* Strategy and M&A: Map markets, evaluate acquisition opportunities, and turn research into clear recommendations.
* GTM and company initiatives: Support strategic projects across sales, marketing, and customer success, including OKR reviews and business cases.
* Executive communication: Turn rough inputs and complex information into polished, executive-ready presentations and content.

At its core, the role asks you to take a problem such as
*'We are meeting this partner; figure out why they should work with Zinier'*
and drive it from research to a finished pitch.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
**Must haves**

* 3-5 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, business strategy, or a similarly analytical and high-ownership environment.
* Direct, client-facing experience.
* A bachelor's or master's degree from a Tier 1 institution (an MBA is not required).

**You will thrive here if you**

* Break down ambiguous problems and form a clear point of view, rather than simply summarising research.
* Communicate crisply in writing, in conversation, and through strong slides and spreadsheets.
* Pick up unfamiliar industries and business models quickly, with genuine commercial curiosity.
* Work independently, care about quality, and see work through to completion.
* Use AI tools as leverage without outsourcing your thinking to them.

**Nice to have:**
Exposure to B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or field service; experience with pitch decks, proposals, or M&A; or experience supporting founders and senior executives.
  
  
**Why This Role**
You will work across business development, partnerships, GTM, strategy, and M&A rather than being confined to a single function. Working closely with senior leadership, you will see your work directly shape customer conversations, partnerships, and strategic decisions, and grow into someone who can own business problems end-to-end.

title: Founder's Office - Demand Strategy
description:
**Mandatory requirement: We’re looking for candidates from Tier 1 undergraduate colleges, like IITs, BITS, NITs, SRCC, St. Stephen's**
, etc., 
**with 1-2 years of experience at a top-tier management consulting firm, a founder's office, and similar Strategy roles**

**About LH2 AI Labs:**

Built by second-time founders who have built and sold companies before, LH2 AI Labs (lh2.ai) is building the post-training infrastructure for frontier AI models.

We bring private, high-quality institutional datasets and vetted domain experts to frontier AI pipelines across verticals like coding, computer use, agentic, medical, audio, and more.

For AI to keep progressing, it needs high-quality training data drawn from real production use cases. The public web has already been crawled and trained on, and there's nothing left there. That's where we come in: we're building a world where frontier models can access data on tap, exactly the way they access compute today.

**You've advised on the P&L. Now own one.**

At MBB, you've diagnosed problems, built the recommendation, and handed it over. This role starts where that ends. You'll run a data vertical as its own business, with full P&L ownership, sitting right next to the founders.

We point you at a vertical (codebases, finance, company operations, medical, audio, egocentric, or whatever's next) and you build its supply from scratch. You figure out who in the world has the data and expertise we need, work out how to win them, and close them. You decide who to approach, in what order, on what terms, and where the moat gets built. What you learn in the field directly shapes what the founders prioritise next.

**What you'll own**

* **Demand:**
  Work directly with frontier AI labs to understand their training data requirements and translate them into a sourcing strategy.
* **Supply:**
  Map the landscape and identify the institutions, companies and experts who hold the right data.
* **Deals:**
  Structure and negotiate licensing rights on bespoke, non-standard terms, and close agreements end to end.
* **Delivery:**
  Partner with our engineering team to build the data pipelines and ensure seamless delivery to customers.
* **The number:**
  Carry revenue targets for your vertical and own the outcome.

This isn't a role where you make the deck. It's a role where you close the deal the deck would have recommended.

**Who we're looking for?**

* **1-2 years in client-facing strategy consulting at McKinsey, BCG or Bain.**
  You've worked directly with CXOs, run workstreams, and held your own in rooms where the stakes were high.
* **Education from IIT and/or IIM**
  (or an equivalent top-tier institution).
* **Genuinely sharp.**
  You pick things up fast, structure ambiguity quickly, and move from insight to action without waiting for a perfect answer.
* **Consultative by instinct.**
  You read what a counterpart actually needs, solve the problem in front of you, and build a deal around it.
* **Owner's mindset.**
  You want to shape how your vertical goes to market, not execute a plan handed to you.
* **Commercial edge.**
  You're comfortable negotiating non-standard terms and can tell what's worth closing and what isn't.
* **Wants the closure.**
  You're hungry to move from advising to outcomes, and you thrive in fast, ambiguous, zero-hand-holding environments.

We can teach you the domain, the data and the AI landscape. We can't teach you to think on your feet or to want the win. That part you bring.

**Bonus points**

* Worked on commercial, go-to-market, pricing or growth-strategy engagements at MBB.
* Opened a new relationship, market or account from cold, whether in consulting business development, a startup, or a side venture.
* Any stint in a revenue-owning role (founder's office, BD, partnerships) before or after consulting.
* Exposure to AI, data, tech, healthcare, expert networks or marketplaces.
* Experience moving small, senior buying committees to a decision.

**Why this role?**

* Real P&L ownership1-2 years out of MBB, a jump that usually takes a decade elsewhere.
* Work directly with second-time founders who have built and exited before.
* A front-row seat to how frontier AI models are actually built, and the data that goes into them.
* Each vertical is a business you build. Strong vertical leads grow into running multiple verticals.
* Competitive base plus meaningful ESOPs and performance-linked incentives.

title: TC-CS-AEET-Senior-ZT
description:

* Demonstrates ability to track developments and changes in the digital business and threat environments to ensure that they're adequately addressed in client’s security strategy plans and architecture artefacts.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6+ years of experience in Information Technology experience, with specialization in Cyber Security roles that include multiple areas of specialization. Professional-level knowledge in areas from the following:

+ Zero Trust Security Strategy and Implementation
+ Security Engineering & Architecture assessments
+ Possess understanding in firewalls, VPNs, NAC, SDWAN, WAF, Proxy, EDR/XDR etc.
+ Expert level experience with deployment, maintenance and operations of one or more major network security Devices
+ Cloud Security Architecture
+ Entrepreneurial approach to solving security problems with consultative skills
+ Well versed with Zero Trust use cases , business & technical requirements.
+ Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
+ Experience in Zero-Trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Guardicore and Illumio.
+ Individual should possess experience in planning, design, deployment, configuration, integration and management of network protection controls including Next gen firewalls- Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Fortinet, SDN Security, DDoS Protection, IPS, VPN, Wireless security, NAC and network authentication solutions to protect IT assets and should be responsible for deployment of any changes, plug-ins, or configuration as requested by client.
+ Proven expertise in designing and delivering SASE transformations across leading platforms such as Palo Alto, Netskope, Zscaler, and Fortinet, including strategy and assessment, vendor selection, PoC validation, architecture design, and enterprise-scale implementation.
+ Plan, design, deploy, configure, integrate, and manage WAF, proxy/Zscaler solutions.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF, Zscaler)

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

description:
**Job Title- Bid and Proposal Manager**

**Position type- Full Time**

**Work Location- Bangalore, Whitefield**

**Working style- Hybrid**

**5–12 years of experience**

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF ROLE:**

The IND Proposal Manager independently delivers moderate‑to‑high complexity proposals in line with defined SLAs, timelines, and quality standards. The role owns first‑draft development, narrative structure, and compliance execution for assigned proposal workstreams, with a strong emphasis on editorial judgment, written quality, and advanced Microsoft Word proficiency.

The role operates with minimal supervision, partners closely with onshore writers, content managers, and subject matter experts, and supports multiple concurrent bids, including fast‑turn and priority submissions.

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Proposal Development & Content Management**

* Independently own first‑draft development for assigned proposal sections or modules, tailoring narrative to client context, buyer intent, and evaluation criteria.
* Interpret RFP requirements, develop and maintain compliance matrices, and identify gaps, risks, and clarification needs.
* Apply advanced editorial judgment to ensure narrative flow, logical structure, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to brand and style standards.
* Create, manage, and optimize proposal response templates and approved content within Loopio or similar proposal content platforms.
* Coordinate SME content reviews and updates to ensure accurate, compliant, submission‑ready responses.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of Aon solutions and terminology across to support accurate and relevant responses.

**Document Production & Quality Control**

* Export proposal responses to Microsoft Word and perform advanced drafting, editing, formatting, version control, and final quality reviews prior to submission.
* Enforce disciplined document management practices, including version control, naming conventions, change tracking, and structured review workflows.
* Oversee formatting of proposal documents, appendices, and forms, including population of required standard firm content (e.g., tax ID, corporate information, diversity statements).
* Provide second‑level quality review of proposal sections, templates, and formatted outputs produced by junior specialists or production resources to ensure submission readiness.

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Partner closely with SMEs, writers, production assistants, and content managers to deliver complete, high‑quality submissions under tight and competing deadlines.
* Independently manage multiple concurrent bids, balancing quality, responsiveness, and delivery risk.
* Exercise sound judgment under pressure, proactively resolving issues and escalating risks to protect deadlines, SLAs, and submission quality.
* Provide guidance, coordination, and day‑to‑day support to Level 8 specialists and production resources as needed.
* Proactively monitor workload, complexity, and competing priorities to maintain delivery commitments and transparency with onshore partners.

**Technology & AI Enablement**

* Assertively use collaboration, content, and workflow tools (including Loopio) to optimize prioritization, transparency, and delivery efficiency.
* Leverage approved AI‑assisted drafting and review tools to accelerate first drafts, support compliance interpretation, and enhance editorial quality.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of proposal processes, tools, and technology adoption.
* Support the development and maintenance of SOPs, templates, and job aids to enable consistent execution and onboarding.

**SKILLS/COMPETENCIES REQUIRED:**

* 5–12 years of experience in proposal management, bid writing, content development, or editorial roles within consulting, insurance, professional services, or similar environments.
* Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills with demonstrated first‑draft ownership and editorial leadership.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex RFP requirements and make sound compliance judgments.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word; working knowledge of PowerPoint.
* Proven experience supporting moderate‑to‑high complexity bids in SOP‑driven quality environments.
* Strong working knowledge of Loopio or similar proposal content management tools.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines across time zones with minimal supervision.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and stakeholder partnership mindset.
* Commitment to continuous improvement through knowledge sharing, training, and coaching.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with urgency and sound judgment in deadline‑driven environments.

title: Customer Manager
description:

title: Zscaler solutions architect/Project Delivery Engineer
description:
**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced
**Zscaler Solutions Architect / Delivery engineer**
to lead the planning, design, and execution of complex cloud security projects. this role is strictly focused on architecture, migration strategy, and project-based execution rather than operational BAU or L1/L2 incident management.

**Work Location - Bangalore/Chennai/Hyderabad/Delhi NCR/Pune/Mumbai**

You will work directly with cross-functional network, security, and infrastructure teams to drive zero trust transformations using zscaler suites.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Project planning & architecture:**
  lead end-to-end design, sizing, and rollout plans for zscaler deployments across global enterprise environments.
* **Zero trust execution:**
  drive migrations from legacy VPN/proxy solutions to zscaler internet access (ZIA) and zscaler private access (ZPA).
* **Integration & deployment:**
  design traffic steering methods (GRE/IPsec, GRE tunnels, Zscaler Client Connector, PAC files) and identity provider (IdP) integrations with Azure AD, Okta, or Ping.
* **Technical governance:**
  define policies, security postures, inspection rules (SSL inspection, DLP, CASB), and architectural standards for client projects.
* **Stakeholder collaboration:**
  act as the technical authority during project phases, leading technical discussions with enterprise architects, CISOs, and network leads.
* **Handoff & documentation:**
  produce comprehensive High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), and operational runbooks to ensure seamless transition to operations post-execution.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  6+ years of total experience in network security with at least 3+ years dedicated to planning and delivering enterprise-scale Zscaler (ZIA / ZPA / ZDX) projects.
* **Core expertise:**
  deep knowledge of zero trust architecture, SASE, SSL/TLS inspection, DLP policies, identity integration (SAML, SCIM, IdP), and traffic forwarding mechanisms.
* **Network fundamentals:**
  solid understanding of routing protocols (BGP), IPsec/GRE tunnels, DNS, and cloud networking environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* **Project mindset:**
  demonstrated track record of leading complex migration projects on time and meeting defined scope criteria.
* **Certifications (preferred):**
  ZCCP-IA, ZCCP-PA, ZCAE, or equivalent industry certifications.

title: Technical Account Manager, (Genius Bar)
description:
**About Copado**
Copado is the leading DevOps platform for Salesforce, revolutionizing how the world's largest organizations achieve success in their Salesforce deployments. Our mission is to accelerate the Salesforce development lifecycle, support digital transformation, and deliver unparalleled value to our customers. We continuously innovate, ensuring our platform meets the evolving needs of Salesforce developers and operations professionals.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Technical Account Manager (TAM) for Technical Excellence teams is a highly technical, strategic advisor dedicated to supporting enterprise and strategic customers. Located in India, this role sits at the center of a high-energy, multicultural, and globally distributed network.
  
  
Moving beyond the traditional scope of account management, this position requires a strong technical aptitude in DevOps architecture, Salesforce release and test management, and pipeline orchestration to provide best practices, hands-on, day-to-day guidance directly with customer engineering and release teams.
  
  
At the heart of this role is our Genius Bar concept. You will act as a technical partner, diagnostic expert, and true extension of the customer’s team. You will leverage deep technical acumen across Salesforce DevOps, Copado CI/CD, Copado Robotic Testing (CRT), and Copado AI (Agentia) to run 1:1 coaching sessions, conduct proactive health checks, host group clinics, and streamline delivery pipelines.
  
  
You will work closely with global cross-functional teams (Support, Customer Success, Services, Engineering, Product), collaborating creatively across time zones and cultures to solve complex pipeline and automation challenges.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead 1:1 diagnostic coaching sessions and 1:Many workshops for customer teams
* Upskill customers on DevOps architecture, test automation strategies, and Copado AI workflows
* Serve as the primary technical contact for strategic accounts
* Conduct regular health checks, maturity audits, and CI/CD strategy reviews
* Provide direct expertise on Salesforce branching strategies and Robot Framework scripting
* Leverage Copado AI capabilities to build scalable environments
* Assist support teams on escalated cases to ensure seamless customer handoffs
* Capture diagnostic learnings into reusable playbooks and product feedback loops
* Partner across global teams to own technical success plans and track velocity metrics
* Mitigate technical risks early across multicultural team boundaries

**What We're Looking For**

* Proven experience with Salesforce metadata cycles and Git/branching strategies
* Solid understanding of automated testing concepts and Robot Framework design
* Hands-on experience or rapid adaptability with Copado CI/CD and Copado Robotic Testing (CRT)
* Familiarity with Copado AI / Agentia platforms
* Passion for live architectural coaching and translating tech concepts to executive guidance
* Calm, analytical approach during high-severity release blockers
* Ability to collaborate effectively across multicultural, global time zones
* Willingness to work aligned with US business hours (EST/CST overlap)
* Background in DevOps consulting, Technical Account Management, or QA test architecture
* Active Copado or Salesforce certifications preferred

title: Implementation Manager - Quote to Order
description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.
  
  
This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
Business Process Manager
  
  
We are hiring 3 Implementation Managers to drive our global Quote-to-Order transformation. You will join a key initiative to standardize commercial processes and digital solutions across our business. Apply for the region that matches your profile and career aspirations:
  
  

* Europe — Flexible location across European countries
* America — Flexible location across American countries
* Asia — Flexible location across Asia (excl. China)

Each role is autonomous and high-impact, with direct influence on how our commercial operations work in your region.
  
  
  
**About The Role**
Join ABB Robotics as an Implementation Manager and drive the implementation and adoption of our global Quote-to-Order process and supporting digital solutions.
  
  
The role will work closely with country commercial organizations to understand their current ways of working, introduce the global Quote-to-Order process, identify gaps and local requirements, and support countries through the transition to the target process and tools. The current solution landscape includes
**CPQ and the commercial Quote-to-Order processes interfacing with SAP S/4HANA**
, together with other supporting applications. The scope may evolve as the Quote-to-Order process and application landscape develops. The position is part of the
**Commercial Excellence – Quote to Order Process**
organization and reports to the
**Quote to Order Process Manager**
.
  
  
This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.
  
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
* Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
* Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.
* Act as the primary business process advisor and second-level tool support contact for your region's countries — balancing process discipline with pragmatic tool troubleshooting
* Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, iincluding the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.
* Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries therough the change management process.
* Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
* Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

**What You Bring**

* 3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
* Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
* Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantageExperience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. You are equally confident with business and technical audiences.
* Experience working across multiple countries and in matrix organizations; structured, self-driven and ownership-oriented.
* Fluent in English; local or regional language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently within your region, particularly during implementation phases.

**The Ideal Candidate**
You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. You know how to sit with a country team, understand how they work today, and guide them confidently toward a standardized global process, without losing sight of legitimate local needs. You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.
  
  
  
**Compensation Package**
**For candidates applying from Italy:**
As part of our commitment to transparency, we want to share the compensation details for this position:
  
  
Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico
  
  
Minimum annual salary: €53.000
  
  
Variable Pay: AIP target % + Eligible for Company Productivity Bonus
  
  
Country-specific benefits will be discussed with shortlisted candidates based on location.
  
  
The offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.
  
  
  
**Benefits As Per Policy**
Flexible working hours, hybrid work options, and a strong focus on work-life integration and Wellbeing support for employees and their families
  
  
Welfare plan with a wide range of personalized services
  
  
Canteen or meal vouchers provided
  
  
We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Oracle Fusion HCM AI Solutions Lead Consultant
Associate (AI) Solution Consultant
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**Role Description**
As an Associate Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.
  
  
**Launch Your Enterprise Software Career**
Your journey will start with onboarding & enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation & demo skills, discovery & objection handling as well as value selling.
  
  
Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.
  
  
During the program, you will be joining the Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.
  
  
This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.
  
  
Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:
  
  

* Discovery & AI Solutioning
* Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
* Scoping business and technical requirements
* Effectively handling objections
* Developing industry domain knowledge
* Delivering impactful presentations and demos
* Understanding value selling and realization
* Managing customer accounts

**What You'll Do:**

* AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
* Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
* Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
* Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.
* Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries
* Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.
* Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Applied AI Value Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached
* Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.

**What You Need:**

* Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
* Excellent communication skills in English
* Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.
* Excellent academic performance
* Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
* Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
* Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply technology to business challenges.
* A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value.
* Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences.
* A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.
* Curiosity, self-motivation, a commitment to continuous learning, and the desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines.
* Foundational business acumen and domain understanding, e.g. in areas such as Supply Chain.

**Bonus Points:**

* Degrees combining technical (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science) and business (e.g., Economics, Marketing) skills.
* Customer-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
* Hands-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects
* Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering
* Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
* Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production).
* Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification.
* Experience with ERPs such as SAP and/or Oracle

This a full time, unlimited position in our Bangalore office.
  
  
**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. title: Solutions Architect
description:

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Enterprise Solution Architect** 
 with expertise in
 **High** 
**Performance Computing (HPC) and Container platforms in Linux\-based environments** 
 to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting solutions including but not limited to installation, configuration, integration and implementation of HPC technologies and enterprise\-grade container orchestration platform.
 



  





 We are looking for a person with very strong technical skills and a proven track record of designing and working with container platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, CNCF Kubernetes, HPC Schedulers such as Slurm or PBS Pro, HPC/AI Cluster management technologies such as HPCM or BCM and the ability to work in a dynamic customer\-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Candidate must have strong proficiency as a Solution Architect in at least three areas and proficiency in other areas.
 


* Leadership and Strategy:
* Develop HPC and container platform roadmaps and strategies for growth based on business needs.
* Engage in and enhance the complete service lifecycle—from conceptualization and design to implementation and operation.
* Identify the growth path and scalability options of a solution and include these in design activities.
* Solution Planning and Design:
* Gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and design integrated HPC and container solutions that align with business objectives.
* Architect and optimize the technical solutions to meet the requirements of the customer.
* Identify the potential challenges and constraints that impact the solution and project plan.
* Opportunity assessment:
* Respond to the technical sections of RFIs/RFPs and Lead proof\-of\-concept engagements to a successful conclusion
* Utilize an effective consultative approach to advance opportunities.
* Innovation and Research:
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and industry developments related to HPC, Kubernetes, containers, cloud computing, and Security.
* Develop best practices, Accelerators and Show \& Tell for HPC and container platform solutions and integrations.
* Customer\-centric mindset:
* Strong focus on understanding customer business requirements and solving complex cloud technology issues
* Be the trusted advisor, delight customers, and deliver exceptional customer experiences to drive customer success.
* Communicate complex technical concepts and findings to non\-technical stakeholders
* Team Collaboration:
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including system administrators, developers, data scientist and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery.
* Understands the roles and effectively engages other teams and resources within the company
* Mentor and train new team members and lead the way in participation in tech talks, forums, innovation.



**Required Skills:** 



* Knowledge and experience with Linux System Administration, package management, scheduling, boot procedures/troubleshooting, performance optimization, and networking concepts.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with HPC technologies, workload schedulers – Slurm, Altair PBS pro, and cluster managers – HPCM, Bright cluster manager.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with containerization technologies like Docker, Singularity, or Podman.
* In\-depth knowledge and hands\-on experience with at least two of the container orchestration technologies like CNCF Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher RKE/K3S, Canonical charmed kubernetes or Ezmeral Runtime. Good to have
* Good knowledge and hands\-on experience with OpenStack cloud solutions.
* Good knowledge and hands\-on experience with virtualization technologies like KVM, OpenShift virtualization
* Good knowledge and hands\-on experience with at least two various Linux distributions like RHEL, SLES, Ubuntu, Debian.
* Good Knowledge of GPU technologies, NVIDIA GPU operator, NVIDIA vGPU technology
* Good knowledge of HPC networking stack (high speed networking), InfiniBand, Mellanox
* Good experience in performance optimization and health assessment of HPC components



 such as operating systems, storage, servers, parallel file systems, schedulers, and container orchestration platforms.
 


* Must be good in any of the programming or scripting languages like python, bash
* Good understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, Routing and Load Balancing.
* Knowledge of network protocols like TCP/IP, S3, FTP, NFS, or SMB/CIFS
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps tools.
* Excellent problem\-solving abilities, analytical thinking, and communication skills to interact with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead technical projects by gathering the requirements, preparing the architecture / design and executing it end to end. Must be able to bring clarity and drive complex projects involving multiple stakeholders.
* Solid business acumen and ability to converse with client on issues and challenges.
* Demonstrates a solid knowledge of the company's breadth of solutions.
* Demonstrates a high\-level understanding of all related vendor product roadmaps.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Solutions Architect, HPC and Container platform Specialist, or similar role, with expertise in designing and implementing complex solutions.
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers and Kubernetes (RHCSA, RHCE), CNCF certification \- CKA, CKAD, CKS is preferred.
* Typically, 6\-8 years of experience in delivering complex HPC and container platform projects.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
WEKA is architecting a new approach to the enterprise data stack built for the age of reasoning. NeuralMesh by WEKA sets the standard for agentic AI data infrastructure with a cloud and AI\-native software solution that can be deployed anywhere. It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that dramatically increase GPU utilization and make AI model training and inference, machine learning, and other compute\-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy.

We’re passionate about solving our customers’ most complex data challenges to accelerate intelligent innovation and business value. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will utilize your strong technical competencies and customer management skills to provide a high level of personalized, proactive, and reactive enterprise\-class solutions and services to our customers. Our TAM team is responsible for managing and maintaining relationships with our customers, ensuring their technical needs are met, and helping them to fully leverage WEKA’s products and solutions.
   

  

 The Technical Account Manager (TAM) role is critical to WEKA’s Premium Services offerings in furthering the WEKA customer relationship and ensuring that our customers achieve the greatest value from their WEKA solution. Working closely and collaboratively within our customers’ organizations, the TAM will understand the customer's business requirements, mission, objectives, technical needs, systems and solutions, environment, and service history. This individual interacts from Staff to Executive level teams and needs to be an excellent written and verbal communicator to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

**As a Technical Account Manager, You'll**
* Provide proactive technical and operational guidance within the framework of their WEKA environment to ensure customers achieving the best possible value from WEKA.
* Establish customer cadence and proactive engagement to align their needs including, but not limited to technical and business reviews, upgrade/release planning, and expansions, and related documentation.
* Identify and address customers' critical technical issues and non\-technical issues, and coordinate necessary technical activities. Coordination of technical activities may include troubleshooting and solving escalated customer issues directly with the appropriate engineering teams within WEKA and 3rd party vendors for multi\-vendor issues when applicable.
* Monitor customer open cases during business hours.
* Monitor customer systems, utilizing auto supports and User Console to identify potential problems and trends and subsequently make the necessary recommendations to resolve them to ensure optimal performance of these systems.
* Track and maintain user configurations and environments.
* Ensure that all recommended Best Practices are adhered to for maximizing product optimization and uptime.
* Notify customers of new product features, field/product alert analysis, and recommendations.
* Help educate the customer on the various tools on the support site and help them understand their WEKA products better.
* Manage special projects assigned by management to meet customer and cross\-functional team needs.
* Build and maintain a close working relationship with both technical staff and Sr. Leadership from the customer team, in addition to building strong collaborative relationships with internal WEKA teams such as Sales, Sales Engineering, Technical Services, Professional Services, and Engineering
* You will build a holistic view of the customer and proactively identify areas where value can be maximized, increasing the footprint of products in the customer's environment over time, thereby enhancing customer retention and reference ability.


**Requirements**
* 10\+ Years experience as a Technical Account Manager (TAM) or similar customer facing role.
* Experience working with customers to identify and resolve critical technical and operational challenges.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work within a Global cross\-functional team environment.
* In\-depth technical knowledge in three or more of the following areas is essential:
* Networking ETH/IB
* UNIX/Linux
* Storage Technologies
* Cloud Technology \- Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Backup and Recovery
* AI/ML
* Strong aptitude for learning new technologies and understanding how to utilize them in a customer facing environment.
* Ability to follow standard engineering principles and practices.
* Creative approach to problem solving.
* Ability to travel to the customers' domestic sites and other global sites as necessary.
* 24x7 availability for after\-hours on\-call support for critical issues.


**The WEKA Way**
**We are Accountable:** 
 We take full ownership, always–even when things don’t go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility \& ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.
   

  

**We are Brave:** 
 We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.
   

  

**We are Collaborative:** 
 True collaboration isn’t only about working together. It’s about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team\-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other and conduct positive conflict resolution. We are being transparent about our goals and results. And together, we’re unstoppable.
   

  

**We are Customer Centric:** 
 Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize the success of our customers, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.
   

  

 Concerned that you don’t meet every qualification above?
   

  

 Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every qualification specified.  You will lead and support SAP\-enabled tax transformation efforts for US\-based clients, helping organizations improve the way tax integrates with enterprise processes and technology.  As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day\-to\-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.

Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.

* Good listening skills.

* Comfortable discussing prices and helping customers make decisions.

 Ideal academic background
 
 Open to graduates from:

 The degree matters less than

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - Gen AI - Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Career Family: AIA – Agentic AI ENGINEER**
**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a dynamic
 **Manager** 
 to join our
 **AI \& Data Tech Consulting** 
 team, focused on driving
 **data\-driven transformations.** 
 The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of
 **AI strategy consulting, data \& enterprise data assessments** 
 and
 **hands\-on experience in leading cross\-functional teams** 
 to deliver scalable and impactful solutions.
   

  

 You will work closely with
 **C\-suite leaders, operating partners, and portfolio company executives** 
 to help them leverage
 **Agentic AI, analytics, and data\-driven platforms** 
 to unlock value, accelerate digital transformation, and create competitive advantage.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* AI \& Data Consulting
+ Partner with Operating Partners and leadership teams to define and execute Agentic AI, GenAI, and analytics\-driven strategies.
+ Develop and deploy AI implementation playbooks, frameworks, and accelerators that drive tangible value creation.
+ Assess technology cost optimization, data monetization, and digital transformation opportunities across portfolio companies.
+ Knowledge of business process transformation would be an added advantage.


* AI‑Ready Data \& Enterprise Data Assessments
+ Assess whether data is clean, secure, well‑structured, and ready for AI i.e.: AI\-readiness evaluation (quality, lineage, security, architecture)
+ Review existing enterprise data to identify gaps and issues and evaluate the strength of data foundations across ERP and core systems
+ Define clear, prioritized actions to fix gaps and enable AI use cases
+ Apply assessments during diligence, post‑merger integration, and 100‑day plans
+ Convert findings into clear business cases with ROI and value impact


* AI \& Digital Transformation
+ Lead Agentic AI initiatives, translating business and functional requirements into agent architectures, workflows, and capabilities.
+ Build proprietary AI/ML accelerators to enhance business processes such as customer care, software development, predictive analytics, and operational automation
+ Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI, LLMs, process mining, and advanced analytics to deliver cutting\-edge solutions

+ Experience with Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, semantic kernels, Autogen)
+ Proficiency in Python and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG)
+ Understanding of basic data structures and algorithms
+ Working knowledge of: REST APIs, JSON, Async workflows


* Data \& Analytics Strategy
+ Architect data solutions leveraging cloud platforms, data engineering frameworks, and predictive analytics models to solve complex business challenges.
+ Guide portfolio companies on setting up data governance frameworks, data marketplaces, and analytics COEs.
+ Design end\-to\-end data transformation programs, from roadmap creation to solution implementation.
+ Strong understanding of Cloud platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP), data visualization tools, and analytics solutions.
+ Exposure to ERP transformations (e.g., Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle) and portfolio tech integrations is a plus.


* Business Development \& Client Management
+ Work closely with account leaders to identify opportunities and develop tailored value propositions.
+ Support pursuit strategy, proposal development, and client orals for strategic accounts.
+ Represent the firm at global analyst briefings, industry forums, and thought leadership platforms.


* Team Leadership \& Collaboration
+ Manage and mentor cross\-functional teams across consulting, product development, and data engineering.
+ Foster collaboration between AI product teams, analytics experts, and sector specialists to deliver integrated solutions.
+ Drive knowledge sharing and capability\-building within the team.


**Skills and Attributes:**
**Educational Background**
* MBA / PGDM / master’s degree in data science, AI, Analytics, or Business Management. Engineering or quantitative background preferred.


**Professional Experience**
* 10–12 years of experience in Agentic AI, digital transformation, and strategy consulting.
* Proven track record in AI\-driven transformation programs, including Agentic AI, GenAI, predictive analytics, and process mining.
* Experience in building and deploying accelerators, playbooks, or proprietary platforms for data\-driven consulting.


**Soft Skills**
* Exceptional client engagement and stakeholder management skills, especially with C\-suite executives.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with the ability to translate AI into business value.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership abilities.


**Preferred Certifications**
* GenAI and LLM focussed, AI/ML, or data analytics certifications (Google, Microsoft, AWS, Coursera, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI‑driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact.
* Collaborate with a team of AI experts, analytics leaders, and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Founding Key Account Manager
description:
**About Fabric** 




 Fabric is an AI hiring platform. Companies use our AI interviews, sourcing agents, and cheating detection to screen and hire at scale. We've run over 100,000 interviews for customers including Meesho, CRED, and Kearney.
 



 We're four founders who've known each other since college, building since early 2025\. Before Fabric, we ran a staffing business to $2M in annual revenue.
 



  





**The role** 




 Most of our revenue sits in our top 10\-12 accounts, and today the founders manage those relationships ourselves. You'll be our first account management hire. You'll take over the top of the book and grow it, and you'll build the playbook that every account hire after you will run.
 



 This is a founding role in the real sense: no team under you yet, no existing process, direct work with all four founders, and a real say in what we build.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* The top 10\-12 customer accounts and the relationships with their TA and HR leadership
* Renewals and retention across your book. You should know an account is at risk 90 days before the renewal call
* Expansion: growing usage inside accounts and landing new teams and business units within existing customers
* QBRs, account plans, and the health signals that tell us which accounts need attention this week
* Customer feedback into product. You'll sit close enough to the founders that what you hear in accounts changes the roadmap



  





**What success looks like after 12 months** 



* Zero regretted churn in your book
* Your accounts have grown in usage and revenue against a number you carry
* Every key account has a live account plan and a QBR rhythm that actually happens
* Three or four of your accounts are referenceable: case studies, intros, references on sales calls



  





**You're probably a fit if** 



* You have 3\-6 years in account management or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with a retention or expansion quota you can describe in numbers
* You've grown accounts yourself and can walk through exactly how, deal by deal
* You've operated without much support infrastructure and built your own process where none existed
* You can go deep on product. Our customers ask hard questions about how AI interviews and cheating detection work, and you'll need real answers
* You're comfortable presenting to CHROs and TA heads, and just as comfortable pulling the usage data yourself



  





**This role is a bad fit if** 



* Your best work happened with CS, solutions engineers, and marketing doing the heavy lifting around you
* You want a team to manage on day one
* Customers love you but your accounts never grew



  





**Compensation** 




 Base plus a variable tied to retention and expansion in your book. Founding\-level ESOPs on top.
 



  





**How we hire** 



1. Fabric’s AI interview.
2. Founder intro call
3. An assignment
4. Assignment review \+ meeting with other co\-founders
