title: Manager - Product and Growth
description:
Location: Mumbai / Bengaluru only
   

  

 Type: Full\-time \| Reports to: Founder / VP Product GTM \| Start: Immediate
   

  

**ANY APPLICATIONS WITHOUT THE PREREQUISITE DELIVERABLES MENTIONED IN THE “HOW TO APPLY” SECTION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.**
**About CredServ**
 CredServ is building the operating layer for financial relationships between businesses — an AI\-native platform built for how companies trade, monitor exposure, collect cash, and reconcile.
   

  

**Live Products Today**
* CredCheck — who to do business with, how much exposure to take, how to monitor the relationship.
* CredCollect — an AI conversation agent that follows up on invoices and gets businesses paid faster, with a human in the loop.


 Downstream: CredRecon. The long game is a global business\-relationship graph. Every customer is a node. Every distributor, dealer, and invoice is an edge.
   

  

 We acquire three compounding cohorts: corporates who sell through dealers; SMB / MSME distributors and dealers; and independent last\-mile businesses who collect from customers. Each cohort has a different product surface. Mixing them is how conversion dies. Read more about what we do: credserv.ai
   

  

**The role**
 We need an execution\-first Product GTM Manager who will own revenue quality and unit economics from week one — and who treats AI agents as staff, not as a slide topic.
   

  

 This is not a brand job. This is not a ‘give me a performance\-marketing budget and a team’ job. Paid social already exists for SMB and micro\-business acquisition. Corporate acquisitions are named\-account work, LinkedIn, and live working sessions. A Grok agent desk already drafts research, iteration, and execution. You will run that desk, sit with customers, force the smallest product changes that move conversion, and be accountable for rupees in versus rupees out.
   

  

 If your instinct is to scale spend before activation is understood, this seat will feel underpowered. That is intentional.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* A weekly number: corporate pilots closed, SMB/distributor organisations that reach a first value event, and last\-mile users who collect a first rupee — not pipeline coverage or MQL volume.
* Unit economics by cohort: cost to a working session (corporate), cost to activation (SMB), cost to first reminder and first collection (micro). Floors are published. Breaching them to buy volume is a miss.
* The daily loop: execute → measure → kill what does not work → specify a product micro\-fix → ship → execute again.
* Corporate motion: named accounts, insight\-led LinkedIn, 20\-minute working sessions (hear the agent on real overdue rows), 14\-day DSO\-sprint pilots, and invites that pull the corporate’s dealers onto CredServ.
* SMB and micro motion: hold existing Instagram / Facebook / YouTube / WhatsApp and on\-ground UGC / affiliate channels to activation and cash — reallocate every day. Do not ‘run the campaign’.
* Direct the existing AI agents (research, iteration, execution). Improve their prompts and playbooks. Do not replace them with a meeting culture.
* Write one\-page product patch specs (example: GSTIN\-first signup, WhatsApp three\-name collect list, shareable agent recording, dealer\-invite claim). Sit with engineering until the patch is live.
* A daily numbers note and a weekly review. Short. No committee decks.


**What You Will Not Own**
* A blank media cheque or a six\-person demand\-gen org in quarter one.
* Making paid social the primary way we reach CFOs.
* Brand campaigns, generic webinars, or ‘category design’ as the job.
* A 90\-day listening tour before touching a customer.


**What This Looks Like In 90 Days**
* You have personally run corporate working sessions and taken at least one pilot to a convert\-or\-kill decision, with dealer invites actually sent.
* SMB activation and first\-value\-event rates have moved because a step was deleted or a journey was tightened — not only because more ads were bought.
* At least one product change you specified is live and visible in conversion.
* Unit\-economic floors have held for four straight weeks, or you have formally changed a floor with evidence.
* You can run the daily desk — including the AI agents — without the founder in the room.


**Who This Is For**
 You have carried a number in a messy B2B motion — credit, collections, channel / distribution software, ERP\-adjacent products, invoice / trade finance, MSME infrastructure — and you can open the spreadsheet, not just the narrative.
   

  

**You Have Done Some Mix Of The Following**
* Taken a motion from founder\-led selling to a thin, repeatable machine.
* Improved a funnel by removing steps, not by buying more traffic.
* Sat across the table from a CFO or a proprietor, heard no, and still closed or cleanly killed.
* Used AI agents as colleagues this month — concrete workflows, not ‘we are exploring GenAI’.
* Worked India: English and Hindi. A regional language is an advantage. You will travel for customer dinners and shop\-floor / godown conversations.

**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** 
 is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100\+ countries make better decisions. Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Customer Engineer is our entry point into technical customer success — a hands\-on executor who learns by doing, builds foundational platform knowledge, and contributes to reliable, well\-documented customer solutions. This role works in structured environments under clear guidance, following patterns set by more senior roles. Success here is about learning deeply, executing reliably, and building the habits of quality and repeatability that define great Customer Engineers at every level.
   

  

**What You'll Contribute**
* Analyze recurring and complex customer\-impacting engineering issues and identify opportunities for AI\-driven automation.
* Build AI\-powered tools and workflows that help engineers diagnose, troubleshoot, remediate, and prevent customer issues.
* Develop prompt harnesses and evaluation frameworks to systematically test LLM solutions against real\-world engineering scenarios.
* Work with code, logs, configurations, documentation, tickets, incidents, and other engineering context to build grounded AI solutions.
* Design agentic workflows where LLMs can reason over context, use tools, perform actions, validate results, and iterate.
* Understand and optimize the complete LLM loop: Context → Prompt → Model → Tool → Observation → Validation → Iteration
* Investigate AI failures methodically and improve prompts, context, tools, model selection, and workflows.
* Build prototypes quickly and turn successful experiments into reliable, reusable engineering capabilities.
* Develop automation that can identify patterns across customer issues and surface potential root causes or recommended actions.
* Measure solutions using meaningful engineering metrics such as accuracy, resolution time, automation rate, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Partner with internal engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing tools and workflows.

**What We're Seeking**

description:

 Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities.  Our business has very high growth in TI and is in a segment where the market is fast growing. We are looking for an application engineer who has the passion and excitement to grow, innovate, take an active role in solving controller \& Power stage technical challenges, create novel reference material for various CPU/ASIC power solutions, provide top\-notch applications support to customers for various applications, defining next Gen multiphase controller \& Power stage for Enterprise Computing/Datacenter market. This is a fast paced, results driven environment that requires broad knowledge, creativity and excellent interpersonal skills on a daily basis. They then collaborate with the full IC development team (design, test, product engineers) to deliver products to the market which are compelling, competitive, cost\-conscious, manufacturable, and importantly, successful in growing TI's business
   

  

 In this role, you will be part of a strong and fast\-moving team with opportunities to:
   

  

* Design and build evaluation modules for Multiphase Controller \& Power stage
* Deeply involvement in the new product development with cutting edge of new Gen CPU/AI server power architecture.
* Actively participate in hiring, developing and evaluating new hires / interns to develop their leadership skills
* Collaborate with design, marketing and product teams to provide high value to customers

title: Network Engineering - Architecture Focus
description:
**Job Description**
 Network Architect / Lead Location: India (Bangalore / Ahmedabad / Remote) Job Function: IT – Infrastructure Engineering Date Posted: ASAP Requisition ID: 80192378 Remote, Hybrid or Onsite: \[Hybrid / Remote] About the Role Here at Kraft Heinz, we grow our people to grow our business, because we believe that great people make great companies. When you join our table, you can expect access to an array of holistic wellness benefits and perks, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, Business Resource Groups (BRGs) to help foster diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all employees, and an industry\-leading total rewards package that emphasizes a high discretionary bonus. Benefits begin immediately upon hire for salaried employees. Get a peek into life here at Kraft Heinz through our Instagram and TikTok channels! Network Architect at a glance… The Network Architect sets the technical direction for Kraft Heinz’s global enterprise network. This is a senior architecture role accountable for the reference designs, standards, and multi year technology roadmap that connect our manufacturing plants, distribution centers, corporate offices, and cloud environments. You’ll architect end\-to\-end across LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, wireless, network security, Zero Trust Branch, DDI, and Azure connectivity — translating business priorities into durable, scalable patterns that engineering teams can build against. You’ll lead architecture governance, influence multi\-year investment, and partner with leaders across Cloud, Security, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing IT to modernize how our global sites connect, secure, and perform. What’s on the menu Architecture \& Strategy
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end target\-state architecture for the enterprise network: LAN, WAN, SD WAN, wireless, branch, data center, network security, and Azure connectivity.
* Define and maintain reference architectures, standards, and design patterns that engineering teams use to deliver consistently across the global estate.
* Set the multi\-year network technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, manufacturing modernization, and cloud strategy.
* Lead architecture governance and design reviews, ensuring solutions meet security, resiliency, performance, and cost objectives.
* Contribute to project planning, including investment cases, funding requests, and program\-level case studies. Zero Trust, Security \& Segmentation
* Architect Zero Trust Branch and enterprise segmentation strategies, including least privilege connectivity, micro\-segmentation, and identity\-aware access.
* Define network security architecture across platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Aruba ClearPass, integrating with the broader enterprise security and compliance program.
* Partner with the CISO organization to align network controls to Zero Trust principles, regulatory requirements, and audit obligations.
* Establish and govern security protocols, business continuity patterns, and access control standards across the enterprise. Routing, DDI \& Core Services
* Establish enterprise routing architecture using BGP, OSPF, and modern segmentation patterns across hybrid environments.
* Define standards for DNS, DHCP, and IP address management (DDI), IP schema, naming, and service resiliency across on\-premises and cloud.
* Architect VPN, site\-to\-site, and remote\-access connectivity patterns for secure, scalable enterprise access.
* Optimize end\-to\-end network paths and traffic engineering for application performance and operational predictability. Cloud \& Hybrid Connectivity
* Lead Azure networking architecture, including VNET topology, peering, route control, private endpoints, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
* Define hybrid connectivity patterns between on\-premises plants, distribution centers, and cloud workloads.
* Partner with Cloud and platform teams to ensure network architecture enables — not constrains — application modernization. Branch \& Site Modernization

description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise\-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands\-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre\-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI\-native approaches into every engagement.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre\-sales leadership, and practice development.
   

  

 As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts


 \#\# Required Qualifications
   

  

 \#\#\# Technical Expertise
   

  

* \*\*10\+ years\*\* of hands\-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3\+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM\-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi\-region, multi\-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000\+ concurrent contacts


 \#\#\# Consulting \& Leadership
   

  

* \*\*Pre\-sales experience\*\* — led or co\-led 5\+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end\-to\-end delivery on engagements with 5\+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go\-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C\-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3\+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions


 \#\#\# Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
   

  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step\-by\-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands\-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi\-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real\-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# Working Model
   

  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands\-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre\-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration


 \* \* \*
   

  

 \#\# About the Team
   

  

 AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI\-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
   

  

 We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
   

  

 \* \* \*
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Solution Design \& Delivery (80%)


 Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi\-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real\-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration
* Lead technical delivery on engagements valued at $1M\+ — owning architecture decisions, HLD/LLD documentation, implementation patterns, and production go\-live
* Build production\-grade integrations with CRM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow), backend applications, and third\-party platforms using Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions
* Implement AI\-powered capabilities including Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens, Lex\-based conversational AI, generative AI agents, sentiment analysis, real\-time transcription, and intelligent routing
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-calling frameworks, prompt engineering, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows within the contact center context
* Ensure operational excellence establish monitoring (CloudWatch, Contact Lens), alerting, disaster recovery, and performance optimization for production contact center environments
* Create reusable delivery accelerators CDK constructs, solution patterns, reference architectures, and automation frameworks that reduce future engagement timelines
* Pre\-Sales Leadership (10%)

* Create compelling proposals develop SOWs, technical architectures, effort estimations, and delivery plans for complex Connect engagements
* Present to C\-suite and senior stakeholders articulate business value, ROI projections, and differentiated solution approaches during competitive evaluations
* Support pipeline development collaborate with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and Engagement Managers to identify and qualify opportunities worth $500K–$5M\+
* Shape deal strategy define technical win themes, competitive positioning, and phased delivery approaches that de\-risk customer commitments
* Practice \& Team Leadership (10%)
* Lead and mentor a team of Connect consultants, providing architectural guidance, code reviews, and career development coaching
* Drive capability uplift work with AWS Connect Specialist SAs and Product teams to enable the team on new features (Q in Connect, multi\-party calls, outbound campaigns, generative AI integrations)

 The Life \& Pension PreSales Manager is a specialist role within Sapiens’ Insurance Practice, responsible for supporting the preparation and delivery of compelling, tailored demonstrations of the Sapiens Life Platform and CoreSuite for Life \& Pension (L\&P). Working closely with regional Sales teams and the broader Insurance Practice, this role plays a critical part in driving new business acquisition across APAC by translating prospect requirements into powerful platform demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept engagements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:\-**
**Demo Preparation \& Delivery**
* Lead the preparation and delivery of tailored demonstrations of the Sapiens Life Platform and CoreSuite for L\&P to prospective clients across APAC.
* Configure the CoreSuite demo and presales environment to reflect individual prospect requirements and use cases, including product types (life, pension, annuity, protection).
* Develop and maintain scenario\-based demonstration scripts aligned to common L\&P market challenges and buyer personas.
* Support Proof\-of\-Concept (POC) engagements, including scoping, configuration, delivery, and documentation of outcomes.
* Ensure demo environments are current, stable, and reflect the latest product releases; coordinate with R\&D and Product teams on environment readiness.


**Bid \& RFx Support**
* Collaborate with Sales, Insurance Practice, and R\&D to produce high\-quality, differentiated bid responses within required timelines.


**Solution Architecture \& Discovery**
* Participate in and support Discovery and Blueprint engagements, helping to define the scope of the Sapiens solution to meet prospective or existing customer needs.
* Define and document proposed solution architectures for L\&P prospects, incorporating the Sapiens Life Platform, CoreSuite, and relevant ecosystem components.
* Support the estimation process for commercial scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are technically feasible and commercially sound.
* Provide input into product solutions designed to meet specific market or regulatory requirements, working collaboratively with R\&D and Insurance Practice colleagues.


**Sales Enablement \& Regional Alignment**
* Act as the presales technical resource for L\&P opportunities across assigned regions, partnering closely with regional Sales Managers and Account Executives.
* Support regional sales alignment by attending and contributing to pipeline reviews, opportunity qualification, and customer\-facing engagements.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of presales assets, including demo scripts, use case libraries, capability matrices, and standard presentation materials.
* Provide internal guidance and training to Sales colleagues on L\&P product capability and demonstration best practices.


**Proposition \& Product Input**
* Provide structured feedback from prospect and customer interactions to inform the product roadmap and R\&D prioritisation.
* Participate in design reviews and approval processes for new R\&D roadmap developments relevant to the L\&P market.
* Collaborate with the Insurance Practice and Product teams to define functional capabilities required to support the strategic direction of the Sapiens L\&P proposition.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience:\-**
**Essential**
* Demonstrable experience in a presales, solution consulting, or technical sales role within the insurance software or insurtech sector.
* Strong working knowledge of Life \& Pension insurance products, operations, and technology platforms – including policy administration systems (PAS).
* Proven ability to configure, prepare, and deliver high\-quality software demonstrations to senior insurance executives.
* Demonstrate ability to leverage AI tools and platforms to develop and articulate compelling value propositions for AI\-driven strategies within life insurance administration solutions, translating complex capabilities into measurable business outcomes for clients and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting RFI/RFP processes.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; confident engaging with C\-suite, business, and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, structured solution narratives.
* Self\-motivated, organised, and able to manage multiple concurrent presales engagements.


**Desirable**
* Experience in working in a Life and Pensions Insurer, possibly in an operational capacity.
* Hands\-on experience with Sapiens CoreSuite for L\&P or Sapiens Life Platform.
* Familiarity with insurance regulatory frameworks across EMEA and APAC markets.
* Experience working within a global or matrix organisation.
* Exposure to Wealth, Retirement, or Protection product lines.
* Knowledge of insurance ecosystem components including digital engagement, reporting, and analytics platforms.


**Key Competencies:\-**
**Customer Focus**
 Understands and anticipates customer needs; builds credibility in presales engagements.
   

  

**Solution Thinking**
 Able to connect prospect requirements to platform capability in a compelling way.
   

  

**Collaboration**
 Works effectively across Sales, Practice, Product, and R\&D teams.
   

  

**Commercial Awareness**
 Understands the sales cycle and contributes actively to pipeline progression.
   

  

**Adaptability**
 Comfortable operating across multiple geographies, cultures, and prospect contexts.
   

  

**Attention to Detail**
 Delivers accurate, high\-quality presales content and documentation.
   

  

**About Sapiens International:\-**
 Sapiens International Corporation is a leading global provider of software solutions for the insurance industry. Sapiens’ CoreSuite for Life \& Pension is a market\-leading policy administration platform deployed by insurers and pension providers across EMEA and APAC. The Insurance Practice drives the presales, proposition, and consultancy capability that supports Sapiens’ growth strategy in the L\&P sector.

description:
**Career Area**
 Engineering
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

 IPSD Application Engineers work in Caterpillar Aftermarket \& Customer Solution organization, belong to S\&CS (Service \& Customer Support) team. This position is 100% focused on third party business, with the responsibility of supporting Dealers \& Distributors A\&I capability. Application engineer will primarily work with third party OEM power system and control team on new product development, and internally collaborate with sales, product group \& engineering team, product support, etc.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Understand customer's business, leading OEM technical relationship becoming a trusted power system advisor. Drive quality, innovation and new business through application collaboration and installation services.
* Execute customer projects through the A\&I process, delivering integrated engines to quality, time and cost targets making timely decisions on approval risks. Alert customer to mandatory and recommended improvements.
* Manage engine spec development, supporting customer and engine design change impact, supporting any A\&I related CPI projects. Liaise with customer personnel at all levels.
* Tune the engine performance at OEM site in collaboration with OEM power and control team to achieve the machine performance target.
* Complete assessment of machine design against A\&I guidelines and complete design calculations. Work with customer on machine design improvements to enhance performance, reliability and cost utilizing existing engine designs where possible.
* Conduct Genset site installation check for Critical EP Projects (for example, Data Center projects).
* Capture customer/ market sector technical requirements, create FRD’s from VOC and support development to translate into standard or bespoke product offering.
* Critical customer information, drawings and production intent photos and data recorded, key actions successfully followed through with customer and machine recommended for production approval with engine warranty cover.
* Liaise with engineering to create applications guidelines that can be practically checked during machine development. Including A\&I Guides, Installation Audit Forms, tests procedures.
* Provide technical sales support to help win new business.
* Track emissions exempt engines at customers ensuring compliance.
* Ability to capture, collate, engine diagnostic data using specialist tools (CANAPE/ DATALOGGER /EST/ET, etc.). Interpret results and draw conclusions and implement permanent solution.
* Evaluate \& Contribute to the design of new products and processes setup.
* Support and drive Dealer \& Distributor A\&I team capability improvement through Distributor Excellence review, responding to A\&I technical queries.
* Fully represent customers in Engineering and Program teams.
* Help support other customer field and service issues.


**What Skills You Will Have**
* Technical Excellence: Provide tailored technical solutions to customers, be a trusted technical advisor to OEMs.
* Effective Communication: Clearly understand customers’ technical requirements, effectively feedback to product group and seek for solutions. Have the courage to manage tough conversations with customers.
* Problem Solving: Uses varying problem\-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate to resolve customer issues during A\&I phase.
* Project Management: Be able to manage project timeline, identify risks and develop risk mitigation plan, ensure project to be delivered to quality and in time.


**Required Qualifications**
* Competent in use of Standard business tools including, Excel, Power Point, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc.
* Speak fluent English and excellent in reading, writing.
* Independently manage customers programs with minimum supervision.
* Well understanding of engine knowledge, performance, aftertreatment, NVH.
* More than 8 years of engine experience including application, design, performance, validation, etc.
* Bachelor degree or above in Engineering


**Desired Qualifications**
* Transmission and hydraulic knowledge.
* EP Knowledge, especially Data Center experience.
* External customer facing experience.


**Additional Information**
* Able to travel globally up to 50% of time to meet customer expectation and support sales.
* Willingness to visit customer site at short notice (less than 24 hrs) to investigate customer critical field issues.


 This position requires working onsite five days a week.
   

  

**Posting Dates**
 September 3, 2026 \- September 16, 2026
   

  

 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

 Experience working in large enterprises, Network service providers have added advantage.
   

  

 ITIL Framework process knowledge will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Experience and desire to work on automation will be valuable in long run.
   

  

 Amiable communication, interpersonal and social skills will make a difference!
   

  

 HPE Networking product certifications (HPE Aruba Networking – switching, Campus access, Data Center, HPE Juniper – JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP/JNCIE) or industry equivalents are helpful.

 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 




 At Anaplan, we optimize enterprise decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform. Acting as a trusted subject matter expert and strategic leader within Anaplan’s Integrated Business Applications organization, the
 **Supply Chain, Strategy and Transformation Director** 
 sits at the Go To Market intersection of
 **Product Management, Enablement, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Partners** 
 .
 





 This role combines deep functional and process domain expertise (In Supply Chain and Manufacturing space) with technical application architecture, consultative selling, and ecosystem enablement. You will support Anaplan’s GTM Teams on all engagements that require your domain expertise, from initial demand generation programs to initial discovery and through to implementation, and expansion.
 





 Preferred Location \- Mumbai / Bangalore / Gurgaon.
 





**Key Responsibilities** 






 Partner seamlessly with Anaplan’s GTM Teams to ensure seamless integration of Supply Chain Enterprise Planning Applications into Anaplan’s GTM motion by:
 



* Contribute to the creation and delivery of scalable knowledge\-sharing initiatives including compelling sales programs, executive presentations, ROI insights and customer success stories, and enablement assets (training materials, technical guides, evaluation frameworks) to empower internal teams and partners.
* Distill deep domain expertise and positioning into crisp, actionable sales tactics. Ensuring Supply Chain Applications presentations and demonstrations are clearly aligned with prospect and customer requirements. Support all stages of complex sales opportunities both onsite and remotely as a technical, process, and architectural expert. Act as ambassador to and advocate for application customers post\-sale, driving expansion.
* Support our Platform, Application and AI Teams with application design and best practices, pre\-market testing and early adopter customers. Capture structured feedback and translate field insights from customer, prospect, and partner engagements to Product Management to shape application roadmap priorities
* Support Anaplan, Analyst and Industry engagements and events as a key thought leader, including producing thought leadership content across diverse media. Contribute to market insights, whitepapers, top\-of\-mind and high\-impact use cases for customer discovery and executive presentations.
* Collaborating with the Competitive Intelligence Team to deliver competitive differentiation in Anaplan’s positioning and value proposition, sharpening battlecards, and providing win reports that drive useable insights and tactics.



 Key Metrics
 
* Adoption and successful completion of enablement by GTM Teams.
* Number of presentations, demonstrations, and other supporting activities of your Domain Applications.
* Total revenue, deal volume, and pipeline value associated with or influenced by Domain Applications.
* Qualitative evaluations and ratings from our GTM Teams.



 Qualifications
 
* **More than a decade of experience in Supply Chain Planning space**
* Demonstrable understanding of Anaplan’s platform and its applications to solve complex business challenges (Or similar EPM / Enterprise Planning / Supply \& Demand Planning solutions in the market)
* **Deep domain knowledge of Supply \& demand planning** 
 , at strategic, operational and headcount levels, the market of Supply Chain focused \- Enterprise performance management, planning and reporting solutions, required processes and best practices, and the key stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* **Understanding of product management, enablement and GTM operations.**
* Proven experience in consultative selling or strategic advisory roles, preferably within SaaS or enterprise software, with the ability to ask the right questions, manage objections, and guide the sales journey from start to implementation and expansion.
* **Have background working in Manufacturing industry – preferable to have worked directly in a manufacturing company in the past before transitioning to SaaS or Enterprise Software organizations.**
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and knowledge\-sharing skills, with a demonstrated exceptional ability in presenting compelling content, performing product demonstrations, leading workshops, and developing enablement programs.
* A results\-driven mindset, able to collaborate across teams, with a focus on contributing deliverables of the highest possible quality and impact.



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

title: Senior Solutions Architect

More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross\-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long\-term, trusted relationships.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner\-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in\-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab\-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision\-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go\-to\-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.


**About The Team**
 The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go\-to\-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
